The clause «يوحى إليك ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يقولوا ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «أنزل عليه كنز» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «جاء معه ملك» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause that is the object of saying.
The clause «أنت نذير» has no grammatical position; a cause for something implied, i.e.: do not listen to them, for you are a warner to them.
The clause «الله.. وكيل» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «أنت نذير».

* Morphology:
(تارك): active participle of the triliteral ترك; its pattern is فاعل.
(ضائق): active participle of the triliteral ضاق; its pattern is فاعل, and its weak letter has been changed into a hamza, and this is the case with every hollow weak verb.
(كنز): a noun meaning "the thing hoarded", from the verb «كنز يكنز», of the ضرب class; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
- Did the Messenger (Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace) conceal some of what was revealed to him?
In this verse occurs the saying of the Exalted: فَلَعَلَّكَ تارِكٌ بَعْضَ ما يُوحى إِلَيْكَ. The address is to the Prophet (Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace). Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says to His Prophet: perhaps you would leave some of what your Lord reveals to you, [failing] to convey it to those to whom He commanded you to convey it. وَضائِقٌ بِهِ صَدْرُكَ means: and your breast is straitened by what is revealed to you, so you do not convey it to them. That is because the disbelievers of Mecca said: "Bring a Qurʾān other than this, in which there is no reviling of our gods." So the Prophet (Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace) was inclined to leave off mentioning their gods openly, and Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent down: فَلَعَلَّكَ تارِكٌ بَعْضَ ما يُوحى إِلَيْكَ — of the mention of their gods. This is what the exegetes mentioned. The Muslims have agreed unanimously that the Prophet (Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace), in whatever pertained to conveying [the message], was protected (maʿṣūm) in it from reporting anything of it [falsely] [Translator's note: the source reads literally "protected in it from reporting anything of it"; the bracketed word is added for sense.], and that he (Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace) conveyed all that Allah sent down to him to his community and concealed nothing of it. And they agreed unanimously that it is not possible for the Messenger of Allah (Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace) to betray [the trust] in revelation and warning, nor to leave anything of what was revealed to him. The scholars responded to this doubt in the verse by saying: the disbelievers used to mock the Qurʾān and laugh at it, and the breast of the Messenger of Allah (Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace) was straitened by that; so Allah, Glorified and Exalted, commanded him to convey what He revealed to him and not to pay attention to their mockery, and made clear to him that bearing their harm is easier than concealing anything of the revelation from them. And it is said: Allah, Glorified and Exalted, despite His knowledge that the Messenger of Allah (Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace) would not leave anything of the revelation, stirred him to deliver the message and to cast aside concern over their mockery; and the Exalted said: يا أَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ ما أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ

safi-cedvel:46-46.t:
* I'rab:
(قال يا نوح) its i'rab has been given [Note: In āya (32) of this sūra.], (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb – an abrogator (nāsikh) – and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna (ليس) defective, non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he" (من أهلك) like من أهلي, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of laysa [Note: In the previous āya (45).] (إنّه) like the first (عمل) the khabar of inna, nominative (marfūʿ), on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "one of (a) deed" (ذو عمل) (غير) naʿt (adjective) of عمل, nominative (صالح) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) (الفاء) linking to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition (لا) prohibitive, putting into the jussive [Translator's note: the source has حازمة, evidently for جازمة] (تسألن) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm).. and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء), dropped for lightness, is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (ما) relative noun [Note: Or it is an indefinite noun qualified by what follows, meaning "a thing".. and the clause after it is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of it.], indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi (ليس) like the first (اللام) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the fronted khabar (به) like لك, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (علم), which is the postponed noun of laysa, nominative [Translator's note: the source has لبس, evidently for ليس] (إنّي) like إنّه (أعظ) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is "I", and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (أن) maṣdar particle (تكون) defective imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and its noun is a latent pronoun, implied as "you" (من الجاهلين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of تكون.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تكون) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being من, attached to (أعظك) in the sense of "I forbid you" [Note: Or it is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e.: I admonish you out of dislike that you be among the ignorant.].
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يا نوح ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) [Note: Or it is parenthetical with no grammatical position, and the clause after it is the object of the saying.].
The clause «إنّه ليس من أهلك» has no grammatical position; the reply to the vocative.
The clause «ليس من أهلك» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «إنّه عمل ...» has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لا تسألن ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: i.e. if knowledge of this has come to you, then do not ask Me ...
The clause «ليس لك به علم» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «إنّي أعظك ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «أعظك ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «تكون ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).

* Benefits:
1- The infallibility (ʿiṣma) of the prophets:
Those who do not hold the infallibility of the prophets have taken these āyas as evidence, saying that what is meant by His saying, the Exalted, إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صالِحٍ is the asking, and it is forbidden; therefore He forbade him from it by His saying فَلا تَسْئَلْنِ ما لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ; and His saying, glory be to Him and exalted, إِنِّي أَعِظُكَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْجاهِلِينَ indicates that that asking was ignorance, so it contains rebuke and threat; and seeking forgiveness and mercy for it indicates that a sin was committed. The answer is that Allah, mighty and majestic, had promised Nūḥ, upon him be blessings and peace, that He would save him and his family; so Nūḥ took the apparent sense of the wording and followed the interpretation according to the apparent sense, not knowing what was hidden from him, and without doubting the promise of Allah, glory be to Him and exalted; so he ventured this question for this reason. Allah, mighty and majestic, then reproached him for asking about what he had no knowledge of, and made clear to him that he was not of his family whose rescue He had promised him, because of his disbelief and his deed, which is not righteous; and Allah, glory be to Him and exalted, informed him that He would drown him with those who did wrong, and forbade him from addressing Him concerning them. So Nūḥ became fearful about his having ventured to ask his Lord about something he had not been permitted, and feared destruction from that; so he took refuge in his Lord, mighty and majestic, humbled himself before Him, sought refuge with Him, and asked Him for forgiveness and mercy, because the good deeds of the righteous are the bad deeds of those brought near. There is nothing in the āya that requires the commission of a sin or act of disobedience by Nūḥ, upon him be blessings and peace, other than his interpretation and his venturing to ask about what he had not been permitted, and this is neither a sin nor an act of disobedience. And in this incident there is said what was said concerning the Prophet's ﷺ ransoming of the captives of Badr; and Allah knows best.
2- Dropping the yāʾ for lightness:
In the Noble Qurʾān the yāʾ is dropped from some nouns and verbs without a grammatical reason requiring it, and the grammarians said that the reason for its dropping is lightness; in parsing we consider it present and parse it. It occurs in this āya in His saying, the Exalted: فلا تسألن, originally فلا تسألني; the yāʾ was dropped for lightness, and it is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. In Sūrat al-Kahf there is His saying, the Exalted, ذلِكَ ما كُنَّا نَبْغِ, i.e. نبغي; and it also occurs in another place in the Noble Qurʾān: وَإِذا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ; and in the previous āya there occurs رَبِّ إِنَّ ابْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِي, i.e. (ربي). This is a feature of the speech of Allah, mighty and majestic, that distinguishes it from the speech of human beings; the dropping of the yāʾ has a purpose and wisdom, and harmony and accord with the concordant musical cadence of the Noble Qurʾān, and in it there is a pointer to some subtle meanings. For example, in His saying, the Exalted, رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ there is a pointer to the nearness of Allah, mighty and majestic, to the servant and His answering him before he has completed the word (ربي). And Allah knows best.

safi-cedvel:47-47.t:
* I'rab:
(قال ربّ) its i'rab has been given [Note: In āya (45) of this sūra.
(2, 3, 4) In the previous āya (46).], (إنّي) like إنّه «2», (أعوذ) like أعظ «3», (الباء) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعوذ), (أن) maṣdar and accusative-governing particle (أسأل) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the fāʿil (agent) is "I", and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (ما ليس لي به علم) like ما ليس لك به علم «4».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أسألك..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being "من أن أسألك..", attached to (أعوذ).
(الواو) conjunction (إنّ) conditional particle putting into the jussive [Translator's note: written thus with shadda in the source; the conditional particle is إن, merged with لا in the text as إلّا] (لا) negative (تغفر) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil is "you" (لي) like لك, attached to (تغفر), (الواو) conjunction (ترحم) imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to (تغفر), and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya) and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "you" (أكن) defective imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as (أنا) (من الخاسرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar (predicate) of أكن.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ربّ ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّي أعوذ ...» has no grammatical position; the reply to the vocative.
The clause «أعوذ ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «أسألك ...» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «ليس لي به علم» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative (ما) [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (ما), the qualified indefinite meaning "a thing".].
The clause «إلّا تغفر ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause that is the reply to the vocative.
The clause «ترحمني ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause تغفر.
The clause «أكن من الخاسرين» has no grammatical position; the apodosis not joined with fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:48-48.t:
* I'rab:
(قيل) past verb, passive (يا نوح) its i'rab has been given [Note: In āya 32 of this sūra.], (اهبط) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (بسلام) a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of اهبط (من) a preposition, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of سلام [Note: Or attached to سلام.], (الواو) conjunction (بركات) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to سلام, genitive (majrūr) (على) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a naʿt of بركات [Note: Or attached to بركات.], (الواو) conjunction (على أمم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of بركات – or to بركات – so it is conjoined to the first genitive with repetition of the preposition (من) a preposition (من) relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to a naʿt of أمم (مع) adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of من, and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (الواو) resumptive (أمم) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ).. its khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e.: من ذرّيتك أمم (السين) particle of the future (نمتع) imperfect verb, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "We", for magnification (ثمّ) conjunction (يمسّهم) like نمتّعهم (منّا) like the first, attached to a ḥāl from (عذاب), which is the fāʿil of يمسّهم, nominative (أليم) naʿt of عذاب, nominative.
The clause «قيل ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يا نوح ...» is in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) [Note: Because it is originally the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).. See āya (11) of Sūrat al-Baqara.].
The clause «اهبط بسلام» has no grammatical position; the reply to the vocative.
The clause «من ذرّيتك أمم» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «سنمتّعهم» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of أمم.
The clause «يمسّهم منّا عذاب ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause سنمتّعهم.

safi-cedvel:49-49.t:
* I'rab:
(تلك) demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn overt on the yāʾ dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: The reference is to the āyas that relate the story of Nūḥ, peace be upon him.] [Translator's note: translated as written; the phrase "the sukūn overt on the dropped yāʾ" is as in the source.], and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address (من أنباء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ [Note: Or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the overt pronoun in (نوحيها).], (الغيب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) (نوحي) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and the fāʿil (agent) is "We", for magnification, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (إلى) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نوحيها), (ما) negative (كنت) defective past verb – an abrogator (nāsikh) – and its noun [is the tāʾ] [Translator's note: the source reads "واسمه" with nothing following] (تعلمها) like نوحيها, and the fāʿil is "you", a latent (mustatir) pronoun (أنت) a visible detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as tawkīd (emphasis) of the agent (الواو) conjunction (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to reinforce the negation (قوم) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the latent pronoun that is the agent of تعلم, nominative, and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تعلمها), (ها) particle of alerting (ذا) demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi [Note: The reference is to the Noble Qurʾān.], (الفاء) resumptive [Note: Or linking to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition.], (اصبر) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you" (إنّ العاقبة) a particle resembling the verb and its accusative noun (للمتّقين) a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar of inna.
The clause «تلك من أنباء ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «نوحيها ...» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ تلك [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from أنباء.].
The clause «ما كنت تعلمها» is in the position of nominative as a third khabar [Note: It may be a ḥāl.. either from the object pronoun in (نوحيها) or from the genitive pronoun in إليك).].
The clause «تعلمها» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كنت.
The clause «اصبر» has no grammatical position; resumptive [Note: Or in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if you are harmed in conveying what has been sent to you, then be patient.].
The clause «إنّ العاقبة للمتّقين» has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).

safi-cedvel:90-90.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (استغفروا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ربّكم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb).. and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ثمّ) a conjunction; (توبوا) like استغفروا; (إلى) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (توبوا); (أنّ) [Translator's note: the source writes أنّ; the particle in the verse is إنّ, and the source itself goes on to say "noun of inna".] a particle resembling the verb; (ربّي) noun of inna, accusative, the sign of the naṣb being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on what precedes the yāʾ.. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (رحيم) khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ); (ودود) second khabar, nominative.
The clause «استغفروا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the response to the vocative in the previous (verse).
The clause «توبوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause استغفروا.
The clause «إنّ ربّي رحيم» has no grammatical position: justificatory (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(ودود): one of the intensive forms (ṣiyagh al-mubālagha) of the transitive verb ودّ يودّ, of the bāb of fataḥa [Translator's note: so in the source; ودّ يودّ is usually classed under the bāb of fariḥa (وَدِدَ يَوَدُّ).]; its pattern is فعول.

safi-cedvel:91-91.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا يا شعيب) is like قالوا يا صالح [Note: In verse (62) of this sura.]; (ما) negating; (نفقه) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "we" (نحن); (كثيرا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (من) a preposition; (ما) relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of (كثيرا) [Note: It may be a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive.
(3, 4) In verse (84) of this sura.]; (تقول) like نفقه, and the fāʿil is "you" (أنت); (الواو) conjunction; (إنّا) like إنّي «3»; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), conveying emphasis; (نراك) imperfect verb like أراكم «4», and the fāʿil is "we"; (في) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نراك); (ضعيفا) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, from the pronoun of address [Note: Or a second mafʿūl bihi of the verb of seeing, if it is mental (qalbiyya).]; (الواو) conjunction; (لولا) a non-jussive conditional particle; (رهطك) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted; (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لولا; (رجمنا) past verb and its fāʿil; (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating, operating like laysa; (أنت) detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative, the noun of mā; (علينا) like فينا, attached to (عزيز); (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (عزيز) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of mā.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «the vocative and its response» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «ما نفقه ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the vocative.
The clause «تقول ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of (ما), the nominal or the particle relative.
The clause «إنّا لنراك ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the response to the vocative.
The clause «نراك ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «لولا رهطك» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the response to the vocative.
The clause «رجمناك» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «ما أنت.. بعزيز» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the response to the vocative [Note: It may be a ḥāl from the pronoun of address in (رجمناك).].

* Morphology:
(رهط): a collective noun (ism jamʿ).. al-Zamakhsharī said: from three to ten, and it is said: up to nine; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; its plural is أرهط, and this is pluralized as أراهط.

safi-cedvel:92-92.t:
* I'rab:
(قال يا قوم) its i'rab has passed [Note: In verse (78) of this sura.]; (الهمزة) for interrogation; (رهطي) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the rafʿ being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on what precedes the yāʾ.. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أعزّ) khabar (predicate), nominative; (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعزّ; (من الله) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعزّ; (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl; (اتّخذتم) past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida), a lengthening (ishbāʿ) of the vowel of the mīm; (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (وراءكم) an adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (اتّخذتم) [Note: It may be attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (ظهريّا), and it may be the second object of (اتّخذتم), with ظهريّا a ḥāl.]. And (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ظهريّا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, of the verb اتّخذتم [Note: It is a ḥāl from the object if the verb is taken as transitive to a single object.]; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (ربّي) noun of inna, accusative, the sign of the naṣb being the implied fatḥa.. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive, with the referent pronoun omitted.]; (تعملون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (محيط) khabar of inna, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to محيط.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يا قوم ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «أرهطي أعزّ ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the vocative.
The clause «اتّخذتموه ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) implied.
The clause «إنّ ربّي.. محيط» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the speech.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of (ما), the particle or the nominal relative.

* Morphology:
(ظهريّا): a word with the relative (nisba) ending, attributed to الظهر ("the back"); its pattern is فعليّ with kasra on the fāʾ, the kasra being one of the changes of the nisba, while the fatḥa is more regular.

safi-cedvel:93-93.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (يا قوم) its i'rab has passed [Note: In verse (78) of this sura.]; (اعملوا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (على مكانة) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of اعملوا, i.e. "being upon your position".. and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إنّي) a particle resembling the verb and its noun; (عامل) khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ); (سوف) a particle of the future; (تعلمون) like تعملون [Note: In the previous verse.]; (من) relative noun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: Or an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is the clause يأتيه عذاب.]; (يأتي) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the rafʿ being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (عذاب) fāʿil, nominative; (يخزيه) like يأتيه; (الواو) conjunction; (من) like the first and conjoined to it; (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (كاذب) khabar, nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (ارتقبوا) like اعملوا; (إنّي) a particle resembling the verb and its noun; (معكم) an adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to رقيب..
and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (رقيب) khabar of inna, nominative.
The clause «يا قوم ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the earlier vocative clause [Note: In the previous verse (92).].
The clause «اعملوا ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the vocative.
The clause «إنّي عامل ...» has no grammatical position: an explicative resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «سوف تعلمون ...» has no grammatical position: another explicative resumption.
The clause «يأتيه عذاب» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من) [Note: Or it is the khabar of the interrogative mubtadaʾ (من).].
The clause «هو كاذب» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (من).
The clause «ارتقبوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the response to the vocative.. and what lies between the conjoined and what it is conjoined to is a kind of parenthesis.
The clause «إنّي معكم رقيب» has no grammatical position: justificatory (taʿlīliyya).

* Rhetoric:
1- The explicative resumption (al-istiʾnāf al-bayānī): in the words of Allah the Exalted «وَيا قَوْمِ اعْمَلُوا عَلى مَكانَتِكُمْ إِنِّي عامِلٌ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ».
If you say: what difference is there between inserting the fāʾ and omitting it in «سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ»?
I say: inserting the fāʾ is an overt connection by a particle designed for connection, and omitting it is a hidden, implied connection by way of resumption, which is the answer to an implied question, as though they said: "So what will happen if we act according to our position and you act?" So he said: "You will come to know". Thus the connection is sometimes made by the fāʾ and sometimes by resumption, for variety in eloquence, as is the custom of the eloquent Arabs; and the stronger and more eloquent of the two connections is the resumption, which is one of the chapters of the science of bayān whose beauties are many.
2- Allusion (taʿrīḍ): in the words of Allah the Exalted «إِنِّي عامِلٌ»; he mentioned to them one of the two outcomes without mentioning the second, and this is an allusion more eloquent than stating it explicitly. Its parallel has preceded in Sūrat al-Anʿām where He said «قُلْ يا قَوْمِ اعْمَلُوا عَلى مَكانَتِكُمْ إِنِّي عامِلٌ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ تَكُونُ لَهُ عاقِبَةُ الدَّارِ»; there He mentioned one of the two outcomes, because what is meant by this outcome is the good outcome, and He dispensed with mentioning its counterpart.

safi-cedvel:94-95.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لمّا جاء أمرنا ... برحمة منّا) the i'rab of its parallel has passed [Note: In verse (66) of this sura.]; (الواو) conjunction; (أخذت الذين ... جاثمين) the i'rab of its parallel has passed [Note: In verse (67) of this sura.].
The clause «جاء أمرنا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «نجّينا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «أخذت ... الصيحة» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the apodosis.
The clause «ظلموا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «أصبحوا ... جاثمين» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أخذت ...
(كأن لم يغنوا ... بعدا لمدين) the i'rab of its parallel has passed [Note: In verse (68) of this sura.]; (الكاف) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (بعدت) past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine; (ثمود) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما بعدت ثمود) is in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (بعدا).
The clause «كأن لم يغنوا ...» is in the position of accusative as a second khabar (predicate) of the defective verb أصبحوا [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent pronoun in the complete (tāmm) (أصبحوا).. and it may be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the latent pronoun in (جاثمين), the khabar of the defective verb أصبحوا..].
The clause «لم يغنوا فيها ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the lightened ka-an (كأن المخفّفة).
The clause «(بعدت) بعدا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «بعدت ثمود» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).

safi-cedvel:13-13.t:
* I'rab:
(أم) it is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) am, meaning «بل» plus the hamza; (يقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is fāʿil (agent); (افترى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "he"; (قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you"; (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition, which the coming condition explains; (ائتوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is fāʿil; (بعشر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ائتوا); (سور) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (مثل) a naʿt (adjective) of «عشر», genitive, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (مفتريات) a naʿt of «عشر», genitive [Note: or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عشر», because the indefinite noun is specified by annexation, accusative.]; (الواو) conjunction; (ادعوا) like «ائتوا»; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, mafʿūl bihi; (استطعتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil; (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl of the omitted resumptive pronoun; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (إن) a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive (majzūm); (كنتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). The pronoun (تم) is in the position of the nominative, the noun of kāna; (صادقين) the khabar (predicate) of «كنتم», accusative (manṣūb), its sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «افتراه» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «ائتوا....» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if you are truthful in what you claim, then bring ten....
The clause «ادعوا ...» is conjoined to the clause «ائتوا».
The clause «استطعتم ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative noun (من) [Translator's note: so in the source; this line appears to be a slip, since the clause is treated as conditional in the next line.].
The clause «كنتم صادقين......» has no grammatical position; resumptive.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the preceding speech.

* Morphology:
(مفتريات): plural of «مفتراة», the feminine of «مفترى», which is the passive participle of the five-letter verb افترى; its pattern is مفتعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.. In the word (مفترى) there is a weakening by substitution (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb); its original form is «مفتري», with a yāʾ at its end; the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa and was changed into an alif, and the yāʾ has returned in the plural.

safi-cedvel:14-14.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (إن) like the previous one; (لم) a particle of negation; (يستجيبوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) [Note: See verse (24) of Sūrat al-Baqara, where there is further detail on the jussive of the protasis preceded by (لم).], its sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn..
and the wāw is fāʿil (agent); (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يستجيبوا); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اعلموا) like «ائتوا» [Note: in the previous verse (13).]; (أنّما) the restraining mā with what it restrains (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (أنزل) a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", i.e., the Qurʾān; (بعلم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nāʾib fāʿil, i.e., "bound up with the knowledge of Allah"; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; (أن) lightened from the heavy (anna), its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (إله) the noun of lā, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative, and the khabar (predicate) of lā is omitted, its implied form being "existing"; (إلّا) a particle of exception; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, badal (substitute) from the pronoun latent in the khabar; (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (هل) an interrogative particle containing the sense of command; (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (مسلمون) khabar, nominative (marfūʿ), its sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «يستجيبوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive [Note: or conjoined to the implied clause after «قل» in the previous verse, in the position of the accusative.].
The clause «اعلموا ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «أنزل بعلم الله» is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of «اعلموا» [Note: It is possible that the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative «ما», which is the noun of «أنّ», and the khabar is «بعلم الله»; in that case «أنّ ما» is written separately.].
The clause «لا إله إلّا هو» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the lightened «أن».
The clause «هل أنتم مسلمون» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.:
if the Qurʾān was sent down with the knowledge of Allah, then will you submit? [Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]
The interpreted maṣdar (أن لا إله إلّا هو) is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the position of «أنّما أنزل بعلم الله».

safi-cedvel:15-15.t:
* I'rab:
(من) a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive (majzūm), indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (كان) a defective past verb, indeclinable, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", referring back to the conditional noun; (يريد) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "he"; (الحياة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الدنيا) a naʿt (adjective) of «الحياة», accusative, its sign of the accusative being an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif; (الواو) conjunction; (زينة) conjoined to «الحياة», accusative, and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (نوفّ) an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), its sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "naḥnu", for majesty; (إلى) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نوفّ); (أعمال) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (في) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (نوفّ); (أعمال) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (في) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (نوفّ) [Translator's note: the source repeats the stretch from «(أعمال)» to «(نوفّ)» twice; translated as written.]; (الواو) conjunction; (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ; (فيها) like the first, attached to (يبخسون); (لا) negating; (يبخسون) a passive imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «من كان يريد ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «كان يريد ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «يريد الحياة ...» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of kāna.
The clause «نوفّ ...» has no grammatical position; the apodosis, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «هم.. لا يبخسون» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the apodosis.
The clause «لا يبخسون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

safi-cedvel:50-50.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction (إلى عاد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [verb], its implied form being أرسلنا [Note: The genitive may be conjoined to the genitive in His saying (أرسلنا نوحا إلى قومه) – āya 25 –, with (أخاهم) conjoined to (نوحا); the conjunction would then be a conjunction of single words, as we say: ضرب زيد عمرا وبكر خالدا.. But the i'rab above is closer because of the long separation, and the conjunction in it is a conjunction of clauses, as follows.], (أخاهم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the omitted [verb], accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the alif.. (وهم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (هودا) badal (substitute) of (أخاهم), accusative (قال) past verb (يا) vocative particle (قوم) the one addressed, a muḍāf, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on what precedes the yāʾ dropped for lightness, and (الياء), dropped, is muḍāf ilayhi (اعبدوا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent) (الله) the Word of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (ما) negative (اللام) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the fronted khabar (predicate) (من) redundant (zāʾida) preposition (إله) genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) (غير) naʿt (adjective) of إله, nominative, following it in position, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (إن) negative particle (أنتم) detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) (مفترون) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «(أرسلنا) إلى عاد ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause that is the reply to the oath: أرسلنا نوحا [Note: In āya (25) of this sūra.].
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (أخاهم), with قد implied.].
The clause «يا قوم ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اعبدوا ...» has no grammatical position; the reply to the vocative.
The clause «ما لكم من إله غيره» has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «إن أنتم إلّا مفترون» has no grammatical position; a resumption within the scope of the saying.

safi-cedvel:51-52.t:
* I'rab:
(يا قوم) like the previous one [Note: In the previous āya (50).], (لا أسألكم ... على الذي) the i'rab of its counterpart has been given [Note: In āya (29) of this sūra.], (فطر) past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "He", i.e. Allah, and it is the referring pronoun (al-ʿāʾid), and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya) and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (الهمزة) for interrogation (الفاء) conjunction (لا) negative (تعقلون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «يا قوم ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لا أسألكم ...» has no grammatical position; the reply to the vocative.
The clause «إن أجري إلّا على الذي..» has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «فطرني» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «لا تعقلون» has no grammatical position; conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.: أجهلتم فلا تعقلون (have you become ignorant, so that you do not reason?).
(الواو) conjunction (يا قوم) like the previous one, (استغفروا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (ربّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (ثمّ) conjunction (توبوا) like استغفروا (إلى) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (توبوا), (يرسل) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the reply to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), the sign of the jussive being the sukūn, and it was given kasra because of the meeting of two quiescents, and the fāʿil is "He" (السماء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. the water of the sky [Note: Or it is a majāz mursal (synecdochic metonymy) whose relation is locative.], (على) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يرسل) by its implying the meaning of "send down" (مدرارا) ḥāl (circumstantial) from السماء, accusative [Note: See āya (6) of Sūrat al-Anʿām, for there is further explanation and clarification there.], (الواو) conjunction (يزد) imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to (يرسل), and the fāʿil is "He", and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (قوّة) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (إلى قوّة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of قوّة, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (الواو) conjunction (لا) prohibitive, putting into the jussive (تتولّوا) imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (مجرمين) ḥāl from the agent of تتولّوا.
The vocative clause «يا قوم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the vocative clause in the previous [āya].
The clause «استغفروا ...» has no grammatical position; the reply to the vocative.
The clause «توبوا إليه» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause that is the reply to the vocative.
The clause «يرسل ...» has no grammatical position; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, not joined with fāʾ.
The clause «يزدكم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause يرسل.
The clause «لا تتولّوا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause استغفروا.

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) past verb and its fāʿil (agent) (يا هود) like يا نوح [Note: In āya (46) of this sūra.], (ما) negative (جئتنا) past verb, its agent and its object (ببيّنة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جئتنا) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of جئت.] (الواو) conjunction (ما) negative, operating like laysa (نحن) detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as the noun of mā (الباء) redundant (zāʾida) preposition (تاركي) genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, the khabar (predicate) of mā, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, and the nūn was dropped because of the annexation (آلهتنا) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive.. and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (عن قول) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from the pronoun in تاركي, i.e. "proceeding from your word" (الواو) conjunction (ما نحن) like the first (اللام) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to مؤمنين (بمؤمنين) like بتاركي.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The vocative clause «يا هود ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ما جئتنا ببيّنة» has no grammatical position; the reply to the vocative, resumptive.
The clause «ما نحن بتاركي ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause that is the reply to the vocative.
The clause «ما نحن لك بمؤمنين» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause that is the reply to the vocative.

* Benefits:
- The redundant bāʾ:
In this āya there occurs His saying, the Exalted, وَما نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ, where the bāʾ has been added to the khabar of the negative (ما) that operates like laysa; so we say: the bāʾ is a redundant preposition, and مؤمنين is genitive in form, accusative in position as the khabar of mā. We shall set out below the places where the bāʾ is added, to complete the benefit, bearing in mind that the redundant bāʾ adds emphasis to the meaning.
1- It is added with the fāʿil. Its addition is predominant and obligatory, as in our saying أحسن بزيد, the original being أحسن زيد; and its addition predominates in the agent of كفى, as in His saying, the Exalted, كَفى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيداً.
2- With the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), as in His saying, the Exalted, وَلا تُلْقُوا بِأَيْدِيكُمْ إِلَى التَّهْلُكَةِ.
3- With the mubtadaʾ (subject), as in our saying (بحسبك درهم) and (خرجت فإذا بزيد في الباب).
4- With the khabar, as in His saying, the Exalted, أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحاكِمِينَ and وَمَا اللَّهُ بِغافِلٍ.
5- With the ḥāl whose governing word is negated, as in the saying of al-Quḥayf al-ʿUqaylī:
فما رجع بخائبة ركاب ... حكيم بن المسيب منتهاها
(No riding camels returned disappointed whose journey's end was Ḥakīm ibn al-Musayyab.)
The evidence in it is his saying (بخائبة), the original being فما رجعت خائبة.

safi-cedvel:54-56.t:
* I'rab:
(إن) negative particle (نقول) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "we" (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) (اعترى) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (بعض) fāʿil, nominative (آلهتنا) like the previous one [Note: In the previous āya (53).], (بسوء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اعتراك), (قال) past verb, and the fāʿil is "he" (إنّي أشهد) like إنّي أعوذ [Note: In āya (47) of this sūra.], (الله) the Word of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); the thing attested is omitted, indicated by what comes next (الواو) conjunction (اشهدوا) a verb like استغفروا [Note: In āya (52) of this sūra.], (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb – an abrogator (nāsikh) – and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of anna (بريء) khabar (predicate), nominative (من) a preposition (ما) maṣdar particle (تشركون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «إن نقول ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «اعتراك» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «إنّي أشهد ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the second saying.
The clause «أشهد الله» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «اشهدوا ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause إنّي أشهد..
The clause «تشركون» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما).
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّي بريء..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. بأنّي بريء.., attached to (اشهدوا).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تشركون) is in the position of genitive by the preposition من, attached to بريء.
(من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of the omitted object of تشركون, i.e. "you associate gods besides Him", and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (الفاء) linking to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition (كيدوا) like استغفروا «1», and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya) and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (جميعا) ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of كيدوا, accusative (ثمّ) conjunction (لا تنظروا) like لا تتولّوا «2», and (النون) is for protection and (الياء), dropped for lightness, is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi.
The clause «كيدوني ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. if you are able to plot against me, then plot against me.
The clause «لا تنظرون» is conjoined to the clause كيدوني.
(إنّي) like the first (توكّلت) past verb and its agent (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (توكّلت), (ربّ) badal (substitute) of the Word of Majesty, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on its end, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (الواو) conjunction (ربّكم) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the first ربّ, genitive.. and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi (ما) negative particle (من) redundant (zāʾida) preposition (دابّة) genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ (subject) (إلّا) particle of restriction (هو) detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (آخذ) khabar of هو, nominative (بناصيتها) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آخذ.. and (ها) muḍāf ilayhi (إنّ ربّي) its i'rab has been given [Note: In āya (41) of this sūra.] (على صراط) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of inna (مستقيم) naʿt of صراط, genitive.
The clause «إنّي توكّلت ...» has no grammatical position; a causal explanation (taʿlīl) of what preceded.
The clause «توكّلت ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «ما من دابة إلّا هو آخذ ...» has no grammatical position; another causal explanation.
The clause «هو آخذ ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of دابّة.
The clause «إنّ ربّي على صراط ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(اعتراك): in it there is a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by conversion (qalb); its origin is اعتري: the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa and was converted to alif, so it became اعترى – with a final alif – its pattern being افتعل; the yāʾ, which is the lām of the word, is converted from a wāw: its bare form is عرا يعرو, and the maṣdar is عروة.
(ناصية): a noun for the front of the head, or the hair growing at the front; in the word there is iʿlāl by conversion: we say نصوت الرجل, i.e. I seized him by his forelock; the origin is ناصوة – with kasra on the ṣād and fatḥa on the wāw – and when the wāw was voweled and what preceded it had kasra, it was converted to yāʾ, so it became ناصية, its pattern being فاعلة. Seizing by the forelock is a kināya (metonymy) for domination and subjugation.

* Rhetoric:
1- In His saying, the Exalted, «قالَ إِنِّي أُشْهِدُ اللَّهَ وَاشْهَدُوا أَنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ».
He said only "I call Allah to witness, and bear witness", and did not say "and I call you to witness", so as to be parallel to it and of its meaning, because his calling Allah to witness to his disavowal of shirk is valid and established, whereas calling them to witness is nothing but contempt for their religion and an indication of little regard for them; for that reason he turned away from the wording of the first, because of the difference between them, and it was brought in the form of a command, as a man says to someone with whom all ties have dried up: "Bear witness against me that I do not love you", in mockery of him and in contempt of his state. This is from one angle. From a second angle, the declarative form admits nothing but reporting the occurrence of calling to witness from him; so since his calling Allah to witness was actual and realized, it was expressed in the declarative form, because it is a valid and established calling to witness; and on their side it was expressed in the imperative form, which includes contempt for their religion, and that is what he intends in this situation. From a third angle, he turned to the imperative form from the declarative form only to distinguish between his address to Allah the Exalted and his address to them, by expressing the address to Allah the Exalted in the declarative form, which is more exalted, more noble and more honouring to the one addressed than the imperative form.
2- Majāz (figurative usage): in His saying, the Exalted, «ما مِنْ دَابَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ آخِذٌ بِناصِيَتِها», i.e. except that He is its owner, having power over it, directing it as He wills, it not being resistant to Him, glory be to Him. Using "seizing by the forelock" for power and dominion is a majāz or a kināya.
3- Tamthīl (representation): in His saying, the Exalted, «إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلى صِراطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ», included in the proof; it is a tamthīl and an istiʿāra (metaphor), because He, the Exalted, is aware of the affairs of the servants, requiting them with reward and punishment, sufficient for whoever holds fast to Him, like one who stands on the highway and guards it; and it is like His saying, glory be to Him and exalted: «إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالْمِرْصادِ».

safi-cedvel:16-17.t:
* I'rab:
(أولئك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject).. and the kāf is a particle of address; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, khabar (predicate); (ليس) a defective past verb; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of laysa; (في الآخرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the implied khabar [Note: or attached to an [omitted] ḥāl (circumstantial) of «النار».]; (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (النار) the postponed noun of laysa, nominative (marfūʿ); (الواو) conjunction; (حبط) a past verb; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of the nominative, fāʿil (agent), and the resumptive pronoun is omitted.]; (صنعوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is fāʿil; (فيها) like the previous one [Note: in verse (15) of this sūra.], attached to (صنعوا).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما صنعوا) is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil of «حبط».
(الواو) conjunction; (باطل) a fronted khabar, nominative; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the resumptive pronoun is omitted [Note: or it is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, i.e., "their deeds are vain"].
(كانوا) a defective past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and the wāw is the noun of kāna; (يعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is fāʿil.
The clause «أولئك الذين ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «ليس لهم.. إلّا النار» has no grammatical position; ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «حبط ما صنعوا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «صنعوا» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «باطل ما كانوا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «حبط»..
The clause «كانوا يعملون» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يعملون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of «كانوا».
(الهمزة) for interrogation; (الفاء) conjunction; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ, its khabar omitted, its implied form being "like others", or: "like one who is not so"; (كان) like the previous one [Note: in verse (15) of this sūra.]; (على بيّنة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of kāna; (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, a naʿt (adjective) of «بيّنة», and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; (يتلو) an imperfect verb, nominative, its sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw; (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (شاهد) fāʿil, nominative; (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a naʿt of «شاهد», and the pronoun refers back to Allah; (الواو) conjunction; (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl of «كتاب», and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (كتاب) conjoined to «شاهد» [Note: There is no obstacle to conjoining (كتاب) to (شاهد) despite the presence of the separator, because the separator is the preposition [phrase].. And (كتاب) may be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the preposition and genitive noun before it, the conjunction then being a conjoining of clauses.], nominative; (موسى) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), its sign of the genitive being an implied fatḥa on the alif, for it is a diptote; (إماما) a ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb), of «كتاب», its governor being «يتلوه»; (الواو) conjunction; (رحمة) conjoined to (إماما), accusative; (أولئك) like the first; (يؤمنون) like «يعملون»; (به) like «منه», attached to (يؤمنون); (الواو) conjunction; (من) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (15) of this sūra.]; (يكفر) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is "he"; (به) like «منه», attached to (يكفر); (من الأحزاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an [omitted] ḥāl of the fāʿil of «يكفر»; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (النار) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (موعد) khabar, nominative, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) a conjunction linking the effect to the cause; (لا) a prohibitive lā making the verb jussive; (تك) an imperfect verb, jussive, its sign of the jussive being the overt sukūn on the nūn, which was deleted for lightening, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" [Note: The address is to the Messenger, upon him be peace, and someone else is intended by it.]; (في مرية) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of «تك»; (منه) like the first, attached to a naʿt of «مرية»; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative, the noun of inna; (الحقّ) khabar, nominative; (من ربّ) like the first, attached to an [omitted] ḥāl of «الحقّ»..
and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) a particle resembling the verb, for rectification (istidrāk); (أكثر) the noun of lākinna, accusative; (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (لا) negating; (يؤمنون) like «يعملون».
The clause «من كان علي بيّنة ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «أولئك الذين ...».
The clause «كان على بيّنة ...» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «يتلوه شاهد ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أولئك يؤمنون به ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «يؤمنون به ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «من يكفر به ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause «أولئك يؤمنون به».
The clause «يكفر به ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «النار موعده» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لا تك في مرية» has no grammatical position; conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e., "take heed, and do not be in doubt" [Note: The link is the link of causation, and therefore the clause may correctly be the apodosis of an implied condition understood from the preceding context, i.e.: if the Qurʾān is from Allah, then do not be in doubt about it ...].
The clause «إنّه الحقّ ...» has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لكنّ أكثر الناس ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the causal clause.
The clause «لا يؤمنون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of lākinna.

* Morphology:
(موعد): a noun of place from the triliteral verb وعد; its pattern is مفعل, with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn, because it is an assimilated weak verb (muʿtall mithāl) whose fāʾ is dropped in the imperfect.
(مرية): a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) from the four-letter (ماري); here it means doubt, with kasra on the mīm; its pattern is فعلة, and it may take ḍamma among Asad and Tamīm.

* Benefits:
- Interrogative «من»:
In this verse occurs the saying of the Exalted: أَفَمَنْ كانَ عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ. «من»: an interrogative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ [Translator's note: so here; in the I'rab section above, «من» was parsed as a relative noun.]. It is well known that (من) comes as interrogative, relative, conditional and qualified (mawṣūfa), but we will speak about one aspect of it, namely interrogation:
1- It is a noun indeclinable on the sukūn, conveying interrogation, as in the saying of the Exalted: مَنْ بَعَثَنا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنا؟ فَمَنْ رَبُّكُما يا مُوسى. In the saying of the Exalted وَمَنْ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ, «من» in the verse is interrogative imbued with the sense of negation, i.e., none forgives sins except Allah. It is not a condition for «من» that has been imbued with the sense of interrogation [Translator's note: so in the source; the context suggests "negation"] to be preceded by the wāw, contrary to Ibn Mālik, as evidenced by the saying of the Exalted: مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ.
2- If it is said: «من ذا لقيت؟» ("Who is it that you met?"), then «من» is mubtadaʾ and «ذا» a relative khabar, and the resumptive pronoun is omitted: that is, «ذا» is a relative noun meaning «الذي», in the position of the nominative as khabar, and the resumptive pronoun in the verb «لقيت» is omitted, its implied form being (من ذا لقيته).
3- Its i'rab is as follows:
a- Mubtadaʾ: if a noun follows it, as in the saying of the Exalted فَمَنْ رَبُّكُما يا مُوسى. It may also be a fronted khabar with what follows it a postponed mubtadaʾ. Likewise if an intransitive verb follows it, such as: (من جار على أخيه أولا؟ ("Who wronged his brother first?"). Likewise if a transitive verb that has taken its full object follows it, such as the saying of the Exalted مَنْ فَعَلَ هذا بِآلِهَتِنا مَنْ بَعَثَنا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنا.
b- It is parsed as in the position of the accusative, a fronted mafʿūl bihi, if a transitive verb that has not taken its full object follows it.
For example: (من أكرم الأمير) ("Whom did the emir honour?").
c- It is parsed as in the position of the accusative, a fronted khabar of kāna or one of its sisters, if a defective verb follows it, such as (من أصبح صديقك) ("Who has become your friend?") and (من كان جارك) ("Who was your neighbour?").

safi-cedvel:96-97.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (أرسلنا) past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (موسى) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the naṣb being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (بآيات) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أرسلنا), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the position of genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (سلطان) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to آيات, genitive (majrūr); (مبين) a naʿt (adjective) of سلطان, genitive.
The clause «the implied oath» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أرسلنا ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the oath.
(إلى فرعون) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أرسلنا), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, since it is a diptote; (الواو) conjunction; (ملئه) conjoined to فرعون, genitive.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction; (اتّبعوا) past verb and its fāʿil; (أمر) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (فرعون) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa; (الواو) of ḥāl (circumstantial) [Note: Or resumptive.]; (ما) negating, operating like laysa; (أمر) the noun of mā, nominative (marfūʿ); (فرعون) like the last; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (رشيد) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of mā.
The clause «اتّبعوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumed clause [Note: I.e. "So Pharaoh disbelieved in them, and Pharaoh commanded them to disbelieve, so they followed Pharaoh's command".. and it may be conjoined to the clause أرسلنا.].
The clause «ما أمر فرعون برشيد» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl [Note: Or it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.].

safi-cedvel:98-98.t:
* I'rab:
(يقدم) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو), i.e. Pharaoh; (قومه) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يقدم); (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الفاء) conjunction; (أورد) past verb [Note: Abū Ḥayyān said in al-Baḥr: "He turned from فيوردهم to فأوردهم because its occurrence is certain beyond doubt, as though it has already occurred, and because of the terror and intimidation in that.. or it is a past in reality, i.e. he led them in this world to the Fire, i.e. to what necessitates it, namely disbelief; but the fāʾ makes this interpretation unlikely." End quote.], and the fāʿil is "he", and (هم) is a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi; (النار) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) resumptive; (بئس) an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; (الورد) fāʿil of biʾsa, nominative, and in it a muḍāf is omitted, i.e. "the place of watering" [Note: Implying the muḍāf was needed so that the fāʿil of biʾsa would correspond to the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm).]; (المورود), which is the one specified for blame, is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "it" (هو) [Note: Ibn ʿAṭiyya allowed (المورود) to be a naʿt (adjective) of الورد, the fāʿil of biʾsa, with the one specified for blame omitted, its implied form being "the Fire"; Ibn al-Sarrāj and al-Fārisī rejected that, and Abū Ḥayyān followed them, because the fāʿil of the verbs of praise and blame is not described, according to the correct view.].
The clause «يقدم قومه ...» has no grammatical position: an explicative resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أوردهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «بئس الورد ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: Or circumstantial (ḥāliyya).].

* Morphology:
(الورد): the noun of the verb ورد يرد, of the bāb of ḍaraba; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn; it may also come as a maṣdar (verbal noun) meaning الورود ("arriving at water").
(المورود): passive participle of the triliteral ورد, its pattern is مفعول.

* Benefits:
- The verbs of praise and blame:
In this verse came the words of Allah the Exalted فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ النَّارَ وَبِئْسَ الْوِرْدُ الْمَوْرُودُ; the verb بئس is an inflexible verb among the verbs of blame, and we shall present below something about the verbs of praise and blame.
1- نعم and حبذا are two verbs of praise; بئس and لا حبذا are two verbs of blame.
2- The fāʿil of نعم and بئس must be accompanied by al-: (نعم الخلق الصدق) (بئس الخلق الكذب), or annexed to something accompanied by it: (نعم فعل الرجل الإحسان) (بئس فعل الرجل الإساءة), or a pronoun specified by an indefinite noun: (نعم خلقا الكرم) (بئس خلقا البخل), or specified by the word (ما): (بئس ما صنعت الخديعة).
3- The one specified for praise or blame may be placed before its verb, such as: الصدق نعم الخلق، الكذب بئس الخلق.
4- حبذا is used like نعم, and لا حبذا like بئس, such as: حبذا الصدق. لا حبذا الكذب.
5- We parse نعم as a past verb for expressing praise, and بئس as a past verb for expressing blame; we parse حبذا: (حبّ) a past verb of praise, and ذا a demonstrative in the position of nominative as fāʿil. And we parse لا حبذا:
an inflexible past verb whose combination with لا denotes the expression of blame, and ذا a demonstrative, fāʿil.
6- The well-known view in parsing the one specified for praise or blame is that it is parsed as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ.
It may also be parsed as a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause before it.
But if it precedes the verb, it must be parsed as a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause after it.

safi-cedvel:99-99.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (أتبعوا في هذه ... يوم القيامة) the i'rab of its parallel has passed [Note: In verse (60) of this sura.]; (بئس الرفد المرفود) is like بئس الورد المورود [Note: In the previous verse (98).. In al-Zamakhsharī's view the one specified for blame is omitted, its implied form being "their gift" (رفدهم), by making المرفود a naʿt (adjective) of الرفد; this is what Ibn al-Sarrāj and others rejected. The apparent meaning of the verse is: how evil is the outcome of the gift — the punishment that is given in addition with the curse of the Hereafter.].
The clause «أتبعوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «بئس الرفد ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الرفد): the noun of the verb رفد يرفد, of the bāb of ḍaraba; it is what one is helped with, of wealth and other things; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn, while the maṣdar (verbal noun) has fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(المرفود): like المورود, passive participle of the triliteral verb رفد, its pattern is مفعول.

safi-cedvel:100-102.t:
* I'rab:
(ذلك) demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).. and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address; the reference is to what has been mentioned of the stories of the prophets; (من أنباء) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) [Note: Abū Ḥayyān preferred the preposition and its genitive noun to be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in (نقّصه) [Translator's note: so spelled in the source; the verse has نقصّه].]; (القرى) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (نقصّ) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "We" (نحن) for majesty, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (على) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نقصّ); (من) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (قائم) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (حصيد) mubtadaʾ, nominative, its khabar omitted, its implied form being "of them (منها) is reaped".
The clause «ذلك من أنباء ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «نقّصه عليك ...» [Translator's note: so spelled in the source, for نقصّه.] is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلك).
The clause «منها قائم» has no grammatical position: an explicative resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: According to al-ʿUkbarī it is a ḥāl from the pronoun in (نقصّه), and Abū Ḥayyān considered that to be a loose usage (tajawwuz).].
The clause «(منها) حصيد» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause منها قائم.
(الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating; (ظلمنا) past verb and its fāʿil, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk); (ظلموا) past verb and its fāʿil; (أنفسهم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb).. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (ما) like the first; (أغنت) past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine, and the fatḥa is implied on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; (عن) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أغنت); (آلهتهم) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (التي) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, a naʿt (adjective) of آلهة; (يدعون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من دون) preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl from آلهة; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (شيء) genitive in form, accusative in position, a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, as it is its description, i.e. "any availing at all"; (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", carrying the meaning of condition, attached to the content of the apodosis; (جاء) past verb; (أمر) fāʿil, nominative; (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.. and (الكاف) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) like the first; (زادوا) like ظلموا.. (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (غير) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (تتبيب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «ما ظلمناهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ذلك من أنباء.
The clause «ظلموا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ما ظلمناهم.
The clause «ما أغنت.. آلهتهم» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "when the command of Allah came, then they did not avail" [Note: The clause may be resumptive.].
The clause «يدعون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (التي).
The clause «لمّا جاء أمر ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "when the command of your Lord came, then they did not avail ...".
The clause «ما زادوهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ما أغنت, the apodosis.
(الواو) conjunction; (الكاف) a preposition [Note: Or a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of nominative as a fronted khabar of the postponed mubtadaʾ أخذ.]; (ذلك) a demonstrative in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar.. and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (أخذ) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (ربّك) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi; (إذا) an adverb of future time, stripped of condition, attached to the maṣdar أخذ [Note: The adverb may be conditional, with the apodosis omitted, i.e. "when He seizes the towns, His seizing is like that".]; (أخذ) past verb, and the fāʿil is "He" (هو); (القرى) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the naṣb being the fatḥa implied on the alif [Note: In the speech there is a contention (tanāzuʿ) between the maṣdar أخذ and the verb أخذ; the second has been made to govern and the pronoun has been omitted from the maṣdar, i.e. "your Lord's seizing of them".]; (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl; (هي) detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ; (ظالمة) khabar, nominative; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh); (أخذه) noun of inna, accusative.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (أليم) khabar of inna, nominative; (شديد) second khabar, nominative.
The clause «كذلك أخذ ربّك ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ما ظلمناهم [Note: Or to the clause ذلك من أنباء ...].
The clause «أخذ القرى ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «هي ظالمة..» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from القرى.
The clause «إنّ أخذه أليم» has no grammatical position: justificatory (taʿlīliyya) [Note: Or it is an explanation of the implied apodosis, if the adverb is made to carry the meaning of condition.].

* Morphology:
(أغنت): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; its origin is أغنات: the alif came vowelless together with the tāʾ of the feminine and so was dropped; its pattern is أفعت.
(تتبيب): regular maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb تبّب, its pattern is تفعيل.
(أخذ): an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the triliteral verb أخذ, its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; there is another samāʿī maṣdar, تأخاذ, its pattern تفعال with fatḥa on the tāʾ.

safi-cedvel:18-19.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) (أظلم) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) (من) a preposition (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) أظلم (افترى) past verb, indeclinable on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (افترى) (كذبا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: Or it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), because كذب is synonymous with افتراء, and the object of افترى is omitted.], accusative (manṣūb) (أولئك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.. and (الكاف) is a particle of address (يعرضون) imperfect verb, passive, nominative ...
and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) (على ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يعرضون), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (الواو) conjunction (يقول) imperfect verb, nominative (الأشهاد) fāʿil, nominative (ها) a particle of alerting (أولاء) a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (الذين) a relative noun, khabar (كذبوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the واو is the fāʿil (على ربّهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذبوا), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (ألا) a particle of alerting (لعنة) mubtadaʾ, nominative (الله) the Word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (على الظالمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar.
The clause «من أظلم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «افترى ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «أولئك يعرضون ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يعرضون على ربّهم» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «يقول الأشهاد ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يعرضون, and the linking element is implied, i.e. يقول الأشهاد فيهم [Note: The clause may be conjoined to the resumptive clause (أولئك يعرضون..), in which case it has no grammatical position.].
The clause «هؤلاء الذين ...» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «كذبوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لعنة الله على الظالمين» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
(الذين) a relative noun with several possible analyses: First: in the position of the genitive as naʿt (adjective) of الظالمين. Second: in the position of the nominative as badal (substitute) from the preceding (الذين). Third: in the position of the nominative as khabar of a mubtadaʾ that is obligatorily omitted, by way of censure, its implied form being هم [Note: And the clause is resumptive.]. Fourth:
in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being أذمّ.
