The jurists have built a ruling on this, namely: if one of them says: إن أكلت إن شربت فأنت طالق ("if you eat, if you drink, you are divorced"), the woman is not divorced until she puts the latter first and the former last, because the implied form is then: إن شربت فإن أكلت فأنت طالق, and the apodosis belongs to the earlier of the two.

safi-cedvel:35-35.t:
* I'rab:
(أم يقولون افتراه قل) their i'rab has already been given [Note: In āya (13) of this sūra.], (إن افتريت) like إن أردت [Note: In the previous āya (34).], and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) (على) a preposition, and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate) (إجرامي) postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on what precedes the yāʾ.. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (الواو) conjunction (أنا) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (بريء) khabar, nominative (من) a preposition (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle (تجرمون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the واو is the fāʿil (agent).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تجرمون) is in the position of the genitive by (من), attached to بريء.
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «افتراه ...» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «إن افتريته ...» is in the position of the accusative as the second maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «عليّ إجرامي» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the فاء.
The clause «أنا بريء» is in the position of the jussive, conjoined to the apodosis clause [Note: The clause may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the first-person pronoun in (عليّ), the governor in it being the meaning of settledness (istiqrār).].

* Morphology:
(إجرام): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb أجرم, its pattern being إفعال. [Translator's note: the source prints the pattern as «أفعال».]

safi-cedvel:71-71.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive [Note: Or the wāw of the ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause after it is a ḥāl from the agent of قالوا لا تخف in the previous āya.], (امرأة) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (قائمة) khabar (predicate), nominative (الفاء) conjunction (ضحكت) past verb..
and (التاء) for the feminine, and the fāʿil (agent) is "she" (الفاء) conjunction (بشّرنا) past verb and its agent, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (بإسحاق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (بشّرنا), on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "with the birth of Isḥāq", the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because of being a proper name and foreign (الواو) conjunction (من وراء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being وهبنا (إسحاق) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), (يعقوب) mafʿūl bihi of the omitted verb, accusative (manṣūb) [Note: Some conjoin يقعوب [Translator's note: so printed, for يعقوب] to the genitive إسحاق, but then the conjoined and that to which it is conjoined would be separated by an intervening element, and that is far-fetched.], and it is prevented from tanwīn because of being a proper name and foreign.
The clause «امرأته قائمة ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ضحكت ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «بشّرنا ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause ضحكت.
The clause «(وهبنا) ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause بشرناها.

* Morphology:
(إسحاق), a foreign proper name, a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf); the alif in it may be dropped (إسحاق) or kept (إسحاق). [Translator's note: both forms are printed identically in the source; the dropped-alif spelling intended is presumably إسحق.]

safi-cedvel:72-72.t:
* I'rab:
(قالت) like ضحكت [Note: In the previous āya (71).], (يا) particle of vocative and exclamation (ويلتا) the one addressed (munādā) in exclamation, a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the alif that is converted from a yāʾ, its appearance being prevented by the place being occupied by the vowel appropriate [to the yāʾ], and (الألف) converted from the yāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (الهمزة) for interrogation expressing astonishment (ألد) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "I" (الواو) the wāw of the ḥāl (circumstantial) (أنا) detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) (عجوز) khabar (predicate), nominative (الواو) conjunction (ها) particle of alerting (ذا) demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (بعلي) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ..
and (التاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: so printed; the pronoun in بعلي is the yāʾ.] (شيخا) ḥāl from بعلي, the governing word being the verbal meaning contained in the demonstrative (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb (هذا) like the first, in the position of accusative as the noun of inna (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) (شيء) the khabar of inna, nominative (عجيب) naʿt (adjective) of شيء, nominative.
The clause «قالت ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يا ويلتا ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ألد ...» has no grammatical position; the reply to the vocative and exclamation.
The clause «أنا عجوز..» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the agent of ألد.
The clause «هذا بعلي ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause.
The clause «إنّ هذا لشيء ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(ويلتا), [it is] ويلة, and the alif is converted from the yāʾ of the first person; a word said at a momentous matter, whether good or evil. Al-wayl is originally a maṣdar (verbal noun) of a verb that does not exist in the language, its case in that being like that of (ويح، ويس، ويب). The conversion of the yāʾ into alif is because of the prolonging of the voice in exclamation, as in lamentation (nudba).
(عجوز), a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) from عجز يعجز, of the class of naṣara and the class of karuma; its pattern is فعول. Masculine and feminine are the same in this adjective. Its plural is عجز, with two ḍammas, and عجائز.
(شيخا), a ṣifa mushabbaha from شاخ يشيخ, of the class of ḍaraba; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa followed by sukūn.
(عجيب), a ṣifa mushabbaha from عجب يعجب, of the class of fariḥa; its pattern is فعيل.

safi-cedvel:73-73.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) past verb and its fāʿil (agent) (الهمزة) for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī) (تعجبين) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and (الياء) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as the agent (من أمر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تعجبين), (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (رحمة) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (الله) like the preceding (الواو) conjoined to رحمة (بركات) nominative [Translator's note: so printed; the intended sense is: (الواو) conjunction, (بركات) conjoined to رحمة, nominative.], and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (على) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) (أهل) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, from which the vocative particle has been omitted [Note: Or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb of praise or veneration, i.e. "we praise the people of the house" or "we venerate them".. and Abū Ḥayyān permitted its accusative as specification (ikhtiṣāṣ).], accusative (manṣūb) (البيت) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) (إنّه) a particle resembling the verb and its noun (حميد) khabar, nominative (مجيد) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «تعجبين ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «رحمة الله.. عليكم» has no grammatical position; parenthetical, of supplication [Note: Or it is resumptive, devoid of supplication, because supplication — in the view of Abū Ḥayyān — is something hoped for that has not happened.].
The clause «the vocative ...» has no grammatical position; a resumption in the context of mercy.
The clause «إنّه حميد ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), clarifying the real nature of the interrogation.

* Morphology:
(مجيد), a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) from the verb مجد يمجد, of the class of karuma; its pattern is فعيل. It may also come from the class of naṣara. The root sense of al-majd in their speech is amplitude.

safi-cedvel:74-74.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", containing the sense of condition, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the apodosis (ذهب) past verb (عن إبراهيم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ذهب), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa (الروع) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) (الواو) conjunction (جاءت) like ذهب, and (التاء) for the feminine, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (البشرى) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma (يجادل) imperfect verb, nominative, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the agent is "he" (في قوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجادلنا), on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "concerning the affair of the people of Lūṭ" (لوط) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr).
The clause «ذهب.. الروع ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "he became bold enough to address them" or "he turned his mind to disputing with them", indicated by the resumptive clause يجادلنا [Note: This i'rab is the choice of al-Zamakhsharī. It has been said: the apodosis is the clause يجادلنا, the imperfect being put in place of the past, and that is the choice of Abū Ḥayyān.. It has been said: the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "We said: O Ibrāhīm, turn away from this", and that is the choice of Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī.. And it has been said: the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "he kept on (ظلّ) or began (أخذ) disputing with Us", because the apparent wording indicates it.].
The clause «جاءته البشرى ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause ذهب [Note: Some make this clause the apodosis, with the wāw redundant (zāʾida) — as in al-Mughnī —.. or it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from Ibrāhīm, with (قد) implied.].
The clause «يجادلنا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive — explaining the apodosis [Note: It is the khabar (predicate) of the omitted apodosis ظلّ or أخذ.. and it is a ḥāl if the apodosis is taken to be أقبل.].

* Morphology:
(الروع), an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb راع يروع, of the class of naṣara; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa followed by sukūn. There is another maṣdar, namely روعا.

* Rhetoric:
Figurative usage (al-majāz): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَجاءَتْهُ الْبُشْرى يُجادِلُنا فِي قَوْمِ لُوطٍ ...», i.e. he disputes with Our messengers about their state and affair; so there is a figurative attribution (majāz fī al-isnād) in it.

safi-cedvel:75-75.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ إبراهيم) a particle resembling the verb and its noun.. (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) (حليم) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) (أوّاه، منيب) khabar of inna.
«The clause ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).

* Morphology:
(منيب), active participle of the quadriliteral أناب; its pattern is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.. It contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by quiescence: its original is منيب — with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the yāʾ — the kasra was felt heavy on the yāʾ, so it was made quiescent and its vowel transferred to the quiescent letter before it, so it became (منيب).. It also contains iʿlāl by conversion, because the yāʾ is originally a wāw, for it is from ناب ينوب meaning "to return"; when the wāw was voweled and the letter before it had kasra, it was converted into yāʾ.

safi-cedvel:76-76.t:
* I'rab:
(يا إبراهيم) like يا صالح [Note: In āya (62) of this sūra.], (أعرض) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (عن) a preposition (ها) particle of alerting (ذا) demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعرض), (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الهاء) the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), in the position of accusative as the noun of inna (قد) particle of realisation (taḥqīq) (جاء) past verb (أمر) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) (ربّك) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr).. and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (الواو) conjunction (إنّهم) like إنّه (آتي) the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (عذاب) the agent of the active participle, nominative [Note: Or it is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) and the khabar is آتيهم, the active participle being annexed to its object, and the clause is the khabar of إنهم.], (غير) naʿt (adjective) of عذاب, nominative (مردود) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «يا إبراهيم ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «أعرض عن هذا ...» has no grammatical position; the reply to the vocative.
The clause «إنّه قد جاء أمر ...» has no grammatical position; causal.
The clause «جاء أمر ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «إنّهم آتيهم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the causal clause.

* Morphology:
(مردود), passive participle of the triliteral ردّ; its pattern is مفعول. The assimilation (idghām) was undone so that the wāw of مفعول stands between the second and the final radicals of the word.

safi-cedvel:36-37.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (أوحي) past verb, passive (إلى نوح) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوحي), (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of anna — it is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn) — (لن) a particle of negation and subjunctive (يؤمن) imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) (من قوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of يؤمن, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as fāʿil of يؤمن (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq) (آمن) past verb, and the fāʿil is "he", which is the returning pronoun (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition (لا) the prohibitive, governing the jussive (تبتئس) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil is أنت (الباء) a preposition (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of the genitive, the clause after it being its ṣila (relative clause), and the returning pronoun omitted, i.e.:
يفعلونه.], (كانوا) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the واو is the noun of kāna (يفعلون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the واو is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا..) is in the position of the genitive by the باء, attached to (تبتئس).
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّه لن يؤمن..) is in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the verb أوحي.
The clause «أوحي إلى نوح ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لن يؤمن ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of (أنّ).
The clause «قد آمن ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun.
The clause «لا تبتئس» is in the position of the jussive (الواو) as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. إن كان المؤمنون قلّة فلا تبتئس ("if the believers are few, then do not grieve"). [Translator's note: so in the source, with «(الواو)» standing in the middle of the sentence; it appears to be a slip.]
The clause «كانوا يفعلون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «يفعلون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of كانوا.
(الواو) conjunction (اصنع) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is أنت (الفلك) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (بأعين) a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl from the fāʿil of اصنع, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (الواو) conjunction (وحينا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to أعيننا, and muḍāf ilayhi (الواو) conjunction (لا) the prohibitive, governing the jussive (تخاطب) imperfect verb, jussive, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت, and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (في) a preposition (الذين) a relative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (تخاطب), with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. في أمر الذين ... ("concerning the matter of those who …") (ظلموا) past verb and its fāʿil (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator — and (هم) an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna (مغرقون) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the واو.
The clause «اصنع ...» is in the position of the jussive, conjoined to the clause لا تبتئس.
The clause «لا تخاطبني» is conjoined to the clause اصنع الفلك.
The clause «ظلموا» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّهم مغرقون» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(أعين): plural of عين, a noun for the well-known organ; here it is used figuratively, i.e. under Our protection and care.
(وحي): it is the maṣdar (verbal noun) of وحي يحي, of the class ضرب, its pattern being فعل with a fatḥa then a sukūn. It may be applied to what Allah sends to the prophets, or it is the angel who conveys Allah's message to the Prophet.
(مغرقون): plural of مغرق, passive participle of the quadriliteral أغرق, its pattern being مفعل with a ḍamma on the mīm and a fatḥa on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ» the report comes in the form for a denier (inkārī), emphasised by inna, to reinforce the speech and to treat the hearer as one who hesitates, because for the alert soul it is a likely place for hesitation about the ruling of the report and for the burden of seeking it. So He said first: ولا تخاطبني في الذين ظلموا, i.e. do not call upon Me, O Nūḥ, to ward off the punishment from them; then He said: إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ, because the speech is a likely place for Nūḥ to wonder whether some harm would befall them — indeed whether they would be drowned — in view of the preceding saying واصنع الفلك. So He brought the report emphasised, saying: they are sentenced to drowning.

safi-cedvel:38-39.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (يصنع) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (الفلك) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) (الواو) resumptive [Note: Or it is the wāw of the ḥāl, and the clause after it is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).] (كلّما) an adverb of time containing the meaning of condition [Note: Or (كلّ) is an adverb standing in for an implied [word], i.e.: كلّ وقت مرور ("every time of passing").. and (ما) is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) in the position of the genitive.], attached to (mutaʿalliq) (سخروا), (مرّ) past verb (على) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (مرّ), (ملأ) fāʿil, nominative (من قوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of ملأ, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (سخروا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the واو is the fāʿil (منه) like عليه, attached to (سخروا), (قال) like مرّ (إن) a conditional particle governing the jussive (تسخروا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the واو is the fāʿil [Translator's note: the source misprints «والراو».] (منّا) like عليه, attached to (تسخروا), (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (نا) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna (نسخر) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is نحن (منكم) a preposition and a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (نسخر), (الكاف) a particle of comparison and genitive (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle (تسخرون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the واو is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تسخرون) is in the position of the genitive by the كاف, attached to (نسخر).
The clause «يصنع ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «مرّ عليه ملأ ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the condition, its protasis and its apodosis form a clause with no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «سخروا منه» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «إن تسخروا ...» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «إنّا نسخر ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the فاء.
The clause «نسخر منكم ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of inna.
The clause «تسخرون» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (ما).
(الفاء) conjunction (سوف) a particle of the future (تعلمون) like تخسرون [Translator's note: so in the source, «تخسرون»; تسخرون is evidently meant.] (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi [Note: Or an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause after it being its khabar, and the interrogative clause stands in place of the two objects of تعلمون.] (يأتي) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (عذاب) fāʿil, nominative (يخزيه) like يأتيه, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو, referring back to عذاب (الواو) conjunction (يحلّ) like يصنع (عليه) like the first, attached to (يحل), (عذاب) fāʿil, nominative (مقيم) naʿt of عذاب, nominative.
The clause «سوف تعلمون ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «يأتيه عذاب ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «يخزيه ...» is in the position of the nominative as naʿt of (the first) عذاب.
The clause «يحلّ عليه عذاب» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.

safi-cedvel:40-40.t:
* I'rab:
(حتّى) a particle of beginning (ibtidāʾ) (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قلنا), (جاء) past verb (أمر) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (الواو) conjunction (فار التنور) like جاء أمرنا (قلنا) past verb and its fāʿil (احمل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is أنت (في) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (احمل), (من كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from زوجين [Note: Or attached to (احمل).] — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies — (زوجين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ (اثنين) naʿt (adjective) of زوجين, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ, as it is treated like the dual (الواو) conjunction (أهل) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to زوجين, accusative, and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi (إلّا) a particle of exception (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the excepted (سبق.. القول) like جاء أمرنا (عليه) like فيها, attached to (سبق), (الواو) conjunction (من آمن) like من سبق, and conjoined to it (الواو) the wāw of the ḥāl (ما) negating (آمن) like جاء (مع) an adverb, accusative, attached to (آمن), (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) (قليل) fāʿil, nominative.
The clause «جاء أمرنا ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «فار التنّور ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause جاء أمرنا.
The clause «قلنا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «احمل ...» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «سبق عليه القول» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «آمن» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second relative noun (من).
The clause «آمن (the second)» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl [Note: Or an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position.].
(فار): it contains iʿlāl by change (qalb); its original form is فور with two fatḥas; the واو was changed into an alif because it came after a fatḥa. Its pattern is فعل.

* Morphology:
(التّنور): In Lisān al-ʿArab, under the root (ت ن ر), it says: «التنور: الذي يخبز فيه، يقال هو في جميع اللغات كذلك، وقال أحمد بن يحيى: التّنور تفعول من النار، قال ابن سيده: وهذا من الفساد بحيث تراه وإنّما هو أصل لم يستعمل إلّا في هذا الحرف وبالزيادة، وصاحبه تنّار. والتنور: وجه الأرض فارسيّ معرّب، وقيل هو بكلّ لغة» ("al-tannūr: that in which bread is baked; it is said to be so in all languages. Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā said: التّنور is تفعول from النار (fire). Ibn Sīdah said: this is as corrupt as you see; rather it is a root used only in this word and with the augment, and the one who works it is a تنّار. And al-tannūr is the face of the earth — an Arabised Persian word; it is also said to exist in every language"), end quote. So the pattern of تنّور is فعّول, because its derivation is from (تنر).

safi-cedvel:77-78.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (لمّا جاءت) like لمّا ذهب [Note: In āya (74) of this sūra.], (والتاء) for the feminine (رسل) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf [Translator's note: so printed; read muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).] (لوطا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) (سيء) past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (الباء) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (سيء), (الواو) conjunction (ضاق) past verb, and the agent is "he" (بهم) like the first, attached to (ضاق), (ذرعا) tamyīz (specification), accusative (الواو) conjunction (قال) like ضاق (هذا) demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject) (يوم) khabar (predicate), nominative (عصيب) naʿt (adjective) of يوم, nominative.
The clause «جاءت رسلنا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «سيء بهم» has no grammatical position; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «ضاق بهم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «هذا يوم ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
(الواو) conjunction (جاءه قومه) like جاءت رسلنا (يهرعون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the agent [Note: This verb, together with its past form — أهرع — is mostly used in the passive form while its meaning is active, i.e. "they hasten"; therefore it needs a fāʿil, not a nāʾib fāʿil. But some parsers — and they are few — parse the wāw as nāʾib fāʿil, as in the Ḥāshiya of al-Jamal.], (إلى) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يهرعون), (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) (من) a preposition (قبل) a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (يعملون), (كانوا) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb..
and the wāw is the noun of kāna (يعملون) like يهرعون (السيّئات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra (قال) past verb, and the agent is "he" (يا) vocative particle (قوم) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ that was dropped for lightening [Translator's note: so printed; the implied vowel would be the fatḥa.], and the dropped (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi (ها) particle of alerting (أولاء) demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (بناتي) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ [Note: (بنات) may be a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of the demonstrative, with the khabar being أطهر and هنّ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).], and (الياء) muḍāf ilayhi (هنّ) detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ [Note: Or a pronoun of separation.], (أطهر) khabar, nominative (اللام) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to أطهر (الفاء) binding the apodosis of an implied condition (اتّقوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the agent (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative (الواو) conjunction (لا) prohibitive, putting the verb in the jussive (تخزوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the agent, and (النون) for protection (al-wiqāya), and the dropped (الياء) is mafʿūl bihi (في ضيفي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تخزوا), on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "concerning the affair of my guests".. and (الياء) muḍāf ilayhi (الهمزة) for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī) (ليس) a defective, non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — (منكم) like لكم, attached to a fronted khabar (رجل) the noun of laysa, postponed, nominative (رشيد) naʿt of رجل, nominative.
The clause «جاءه قومه....» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause consisting of the condition, its verb and its apodosis.
The clause «يهرعون إليه» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from قوم.
The clause «كانوا يعملون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from قوم [Note: Or parenthetical, with no grammatical position.].
The clause «يعملون ...» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «the vocative and its reply..» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «هؤلاء بناتي» has no grammatical position; the reply to the vocative.
The clause «هنّ أطهر ...» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption [Note: It may be a ḥāl from بناتي, the governing word being the meaning of the demonstrative.].
The clause «اتّقوا الله» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are rightly guided, then fear Allah".
The clause «لا تخزون ...» is conjoined to the clause اتّقوا الله.
The clause «أليس منكم رجل ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive, explaining the implied conditional clause.

* Morphology:
(ضاق), it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion: its original is ضيق — its imperfect being يضيق — and when the yāʾ was voweled after a fatḥa, it was converted into alif.
(ذرعا), an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb ذرع يذرع, of the class of fataḥa, meaning "he measured with the forearm". Al-Azharī said: al-dharʿ is put in the place of capacity (al-ṭāqa), and al-dharʿ is a metonymy for ability (al-wusʿ). Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa followed by sukūn.
(عصيب), an intensive form (ṣīghat mubālagha) of the active participle from the verb عصب يعصب الشيء, "he tied it", of the class of ḍaraba, and it is transitive; or it is a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) from the verb عصب يعصب اللحم, "the meat had many sinews", of the class of fariḥa, and the adjective from it comes on the pattern فعل, with fatḥa followed by kasra.
(ضيف), al-ḍayf is originally a maṣdar, then it was applied to one who comes by night, so it became a non-derived (jāmid) noun. It is applied to singular and plural, and to masculine and feminine. It may be dualised, so one says ضيفان, and pluralised, so one says أضياف, ضيوف and ضيفان. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa followed by sukūn.
(رشيد), a ṣifa mushabbaha from the verb رشد يرشد, of the class of naṣara and the class of fariḥa, both intransitive. One says رشد أمره, i.e. رشد فيه — with kasra on the shīn — i.e. it went straight. Its pattern is فعيل.

* Benefits:
- Is it valid to marry a believing woman to a disbeliever?
In this āya there occurs an ambiguity, namely that Lūṭ, upon him be blessings and peace, said to his disbelieving people, when they came in upon him and intended to commit the indecency with his guests from among the angels — being ignorant of their true state — he said to them: هؤُلاءِ بَناتِي هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ. The exegetes have removed the veil from the ambiguity occurring in the noble āya and responded to it with several views:
1- It has been said that at that time it was permitted to marry a Muslim woman to a disbeliever. And al-Ḥasan ibn al-Mufaḍḍal said: he offered his daughters to them on condition of Islam.
2- Mujāhid and Saʿīd ibn Jubayr said: by his daughters he meant the women of his people, and he attributed them to himself because every prophet is the father of his community, and he is like a parent to them. This view is the correct one and the closest to what is right, if Allah the Exalted wills. The proof of it is that the daughters of Lūṭ were two, and they were not sufficient for the crowd; and it is not of decency for a man to offer his daughters to his enemies to marry them to them, so how would it befit the rank of the prophets to offer their daughters to the disbelievers?
3- It has been said: Lūṭ only said that by way of warding off his people, not in earnest, and as guidance for them to the path of what is right and to lawful marriage.

safi-cedvel:79-80.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) past verb and its fāʿil (agent) (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath (قد) particle of realisation (taḥqīq) (علمت) past verb and its agent (ما) a negating particle (اللام) a preposition, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate) (في بنات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from حقّ, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition (حقّ) genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) (الواو) conjunction (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) (تعلم) imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "you" (ما) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: al-ʿUkbarī permitted making it interrogative, in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause نريد, the clause being the object of تعلم, which has been suspended (taʿlīq) by the interrogative; and al-Jamal permitted making it a maṣdar-forming particle, the interpreted maṣdar being the object of تعلم.]
, and the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted (نريد) imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "we".
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «علمت ...» has no grammatical position; the reply to the implied oath, and the implied oath clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ما لنا ... من حقّ» is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the verb of knowing, which is suspended by the negation.
The clause «إنّك لتعلم ...» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause that is the reply to the oath.
The clause «تعلم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «نريد» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
(قال) past verb, and the agent is "he" (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb (لي) like لنا, attached to a fronted khabar (الباء) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl from قوّة [Note: I.e. "strength to repel you", so the bāʾ is causal, and there is an omitted muḍāf in it.] — a naʿt (adjective) placed before the noun it qualifies — (قوّة) the noun of anna, accusative (manṣūb).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أنّ لي بكم قوّة) is in the position of nominative as the agent of an omitted verb, its implied form being ثبت, i.e. "if the existence of strength for me were established" (أو) a conjunction (آوي) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the agent is "I" (إلى ركن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آوي), (شديد) naʿt of ركن, genitive.
The clause «لو (ثبت) وجود قوّة ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying for the verb قال.. and the clause قال has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).. and the apodosis (jawāb) of (لو) is omitted, its implied form being "I would have struck you down".
The clause «آوي ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the implied clause (ثبت) [Note: This is the view of al-Mubarrad, despite (آوي) coming as an imperfect.. Or it is the khabar of an implied (أنّي), i.e. "and that I take refuge", and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar that is the agent of ثبت.. Moreover, according to the view of Abū al-Baqāʾ, the clause may be resumptive, i.e. بل اوي.].

* Morphology:
(ركن), a noun for the side of a mountain or something else; its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma followed by sukūn. Its plural is أركان and أركن, with fatḥa followed by ḍamma.

* Rhetoric:
Metaphor (al-istiʿāra): in His saying, the Exalted, «أَوْ آوِي إِلى رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ».
I.e. "I would resort to a strong clan that would protect me from you". Al-rukn is literal for the corners (pillars) of a building on which the building rests; then it is used figuratively for the clan relied upon for help and support, likening reliance on it to the building's reliance on its pillars.
Borrowing al-rukn for the helper is more eloquent, because the pillar is seen and touched in the building's resting upon it, unlike the helper, who is not perceived insofar as he is a helper; so the metaphor here is primary (aṣliyya).

* Benefits:
- The redundancy of (من):
In this āya (من) occurs as a redundant preposition in His saying, the Exalted, ما لَنا فِي بَناتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ; so من is a redundant preposition, and حق is genitive in form, nominative in position as a mubtadaʾ, the implied form being: مالنا حق في بناتك. To complete the benefit, we will speak about the redundancy of من:
1- Redundant من comes to emphasise generality, e.g. (ما جاءني من أحد). The conditions of its redundancy are three things:
a- That a negation, a prohibition or an interrogation with هل precedes: as in His saying, the Exalted, وَما تَسْقُطُ مِنْ وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُها, ما تَرى فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمنِ مِنْ تَفاوُتٍ, فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرى مِنْ فُطُورٍ.
b- That its genitive noun is indefinite, as has passed in the examples.
c- That its genitive noun is an agent, as has passed in His saying, the Exalted, وَما تَسْقُطُ مِنْ وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُها, or a direct object, as in His saying, the Exalted, فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرى مِنْ فُطُورٍ, or a mubtadaʾ, as has passed in the noble āya under discussion, ما لَنا فِي بَناتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍ.

safi-cedvel:103-109.t:
* I'rab:
(انّ) a particle of emphasis (في) a preposition (ذلك) a demonstrative in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted predicate of inna (اللام) the lām of emphasis (آية) the noun of inna, postposed, accusative (اللام) a preposition (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) in the position of a genitive, attached to an adjective (naʿt) of آية (خاف) a past verb, and its agent is a latent "he", which is the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) (عذاب) direct object (mafʿūl bihi), accusative (الآخرة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (ذلك) its i'rab has been given earlier [Note: In verse (100) of this surah.] and the demonstrative refers to the Day of Resurrection (يوم) khabar (predicate), nominative (مجموع) naʿt (adjective) of يوم, nominative [Note: Ibn ʿAṭiyya allowed it to be a predicate preceding the mubtadaʾ (الناس); Abū Ḥayyān rejected this because the pronoun in مجموع is singular, whereas it ought to be plural, i.e. "gathered for it are the people".] , (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to مجموع (الناس) the deputy agent (nāʾib fāʿil) of مجموع, for it is a passive participle, nominative (الواو) a conjunction (ذلك يوم مشهود) like ذلك يوم مجموع.
Clause: «إنّ في ذلك لآية ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «خاف ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
And the clause: «ذلك يوم ... » has no grammatical position, a clarifying resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
And the clause: «ذلك يوم (الثانية) » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the last resumptive clause.
(الواو) a conjunction (ما) negative (نؤخّرة) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الهاء) is the direct object, and the agent is "we", expressing majesty (إلّا) a particle of restriction (لأجل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نؤخّره) , (معدود) naʿt of أجل, genitive like it.
And the clause: «ما نؤخّره» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ذلك يوم مجموع..
(يوم) adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative, attached to (تكلّم) , (يأتي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ, and the agent is a latent "he" referring to يوم in (يوم مجموع..) [Note: or to the divine name, as in the saying of the Exalted: هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ.. but the i'rab above is the more apparent.] , (لا) negative (تكلّم) an imperfect verb, nominative, from which one of the two tāʾs has been omitted (نفس) agent (fāʿil), nominative (إلّا) like the first (بإذنه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (لا تكلّم) [Note: or to an omitted adjective of نفس, i.e. "except speaking by His leave".] .. and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (الفاء) causal (منهم شقيّ وسعيد) like منها قائم وحصيد [Note: In verse (100) of this surah.] .
And the clause: «يأتي ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «لا تكلم نفس» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of يأتي, and the returning pronoun in the clause is omitted, i.e. "no soul speaks in it".
And the clause: «منهم شقيّ..» has no grammatical position, causal.
And the clause: « (منهم) سعيد» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the causal clause.
(الفاء) a conjunction of consequence (tafrīʿiyya) (أمّا) a particle of condition and detailing (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (شقوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the omitted yāʾ because of the meeting of two quiescent letters after the weakening change.. and the wāw is the agent (الفاء) the connecting particle of the apodosis of أمّا (في النار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to a preposed khabar (في) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the omitted khabar [Note: or to an omitted ḥāl from زفير, an adjective that precedes the thing described.] , (زفير) a postposed mubtadaʾ, nominative (شهيق) conjoined to زفير with the wāw, nominative like it.
And the clause: «الذين شقوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the causal clause.
And the clause: «شقوا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «لهم.. زفير» has no grammatical position, a clarifying resumption [Note: or in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from النار.] .
(خالدين) a ḥāl, accusative, from the pronoun in (لهم) , the operator in it being what operates in the preposition and its genitive noun, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ (فيها) like the first, attached to خالدين (ما) a maṣdar particle with temporal sense (دامت) a complete past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine (السموات) agent, nominative (الأرض) conjoined to السموات with the wāw, nominative like it.
And the interpreted maṣdar (ما دامت..) is in the position of an accusative as a temporal adverbial, attached to خالدين, i.e. "for the duration of their remaining" [Note: What is meant by this time-limit is perpetuity, as the Arabs say "as long as Thabīr stands" and "as long as a star shines"; the Arabs set this down to mean perpetuity, without regard to whether Thabīr or the star perishes or does not perish.] (إلا) a particle of exception (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of an accusative as the excepted, either connected (muttaṣil) or disconnected (munqaṭiʿ) [Note: It is possible that (ما) means (من), meaning thereby the disbelievers who were wretched..
And it is possible that it means "the period", i.e. the duration of the remaining of the heavens and the earth, except the period by which Allah wishes to add to that.] (شاء) a past verb (ربّك) agent, nominative.. and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi, and the object of شاء is omitted, i.e. "his rescue from the Fire" or "the increase of their duration" (إنّ ربّك فعّال) like إنّ أخذه أليم [Note: In verse (102) of the surah.] , (اللام) redundant (zāʾida), for reinforcement (ما) a relative noun, whose remote position is accusative as a direct object of the intensive form فعّال (يريد) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "he", i.e. Allah.
And the clause: «دامت السموات» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-like relative (ما) .
And the clause: «شاء ربّك ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the first relative noun (ما) .
And the clause: «إنّ ربّك فعّال» has no grammatical position, causal.
And the clause: «يريد» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما) .
(الواو) a conjunction (أمّا الذين.. شاء ربّك) like the first, its counterpart, and (سعدوا) a passive past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the deputy agent (عطاء) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the verbal noun of an omitted verb, confirming the content of the preceding sentence (غير) naʿt of عطاء, accusative (مجذوذ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
And the clause: «الذين سعدوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause الذين شقوا..
And the clause: «دامت السموات ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-like relative (ما) .
And the clause: «شاء ربّك ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (ما) .
(الفاء) the connecting particle of an implied conditional apodosis (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing (تك) a defective imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the overt sukūn on the nūn that was dropped for lightness, and its noun is a latent pronoun, implied "you" (في مرية) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of تك (من) a preposition (ما) a maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of a genitive, with the returning pronoun omitted and the clause a ṣila.. and it may be attached to an adjective of مرية.] , (يعبد) an imperfect verb, nominative (ها) a particle of alerting (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable in the position of a nominative, agent (ما) negative (يعبدون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the agent (إلّا) a particle of restriction (الكاف) a preposition (ما) a maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of a genitive, with the returning pronoun omitted and the clause a ṣila; the sense is:
"they worship only idols like those their fathers worship".] (يعبد) like the first (آباؤهم) agent, nominative.. and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi (من) a preposition (قبل) a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of a genitive, attached to (يعبد) .
And the first interpreted maṣdar (ما يعبد..) is in the position of a genitive by (من) , attached to مرية.
And the second interpreted maṣdar (ما يعبد..) is in the position of a genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq of the verb يعبدون, i.e. "they worship only with a worship like the worship of their fathers".
(الواو) a conjunction (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb, and its noun (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) (موفّوهم) khabar of inna, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.. and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (نصيبهم) direct object of the active participle موفّوهم.. and (هم) like the last (غير) a ḥāl, accusative, from نصيب (منقوص) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
And the clause: «لا تك في مرية ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if knowledge of this has come to you, then do not be in doubt" [Note: It may be cut off as a resumption, in which case it has no position.] .
And the clause: «يعبد هؤلاء» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-like relative (ما) .
And the clause: «ما يعبدون إلّا ... » has no grammatical position, causal.
And the clause: «يعبد آباؤهم» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second particle-like relative (ما) .
And the clause: «إنّا لموفّوهم ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the causal clause.

* Morphology:
(مجموع) , a passive participle from the triliteral جمع, its pattern is مفعول.
(مشهود) a passive participle from the triliteral شهد, its pattern is مفعول.
(شقيّ) , an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from شقي يشقى of the bāb فرح, its pattern is فعيل.. It contains a weakening change by substitution: the wāw was turned into yāʾ because the origin is شقيو; the yāʾ and wāw met, the first of them quiescent, so the wāw was turned into yāʾ and assimilated into the first yāʾ.. The verbal noun is الشقاوة and الشقوة.
(سعيد) , an assimilated adjective from سعد يسعد of the bāb فرح, its pattern is فعيل.
(زفير) , a verbal noun of زفر يزفر of the bāb ضرب, its pattern is فعيل, and this pattern is the rule for the verbal noun of a verb denoting a sound.. There is another verbal noun, زفر with fatḥa then sukūn.. And الزفير is the expelling of the breath, and it may be taken from الزفر, which is carrying on the back.
(شهيق) , a verbal noun of شهق يشهق of the bāb فرح, its pattern is فعيل, and it is the opposite of الزفير.
(شقوا) , contains a weakening change by omission; its origin is شقيوا, the ḍamma on the yāʾ was found heavy so it was made quiescent and its vowel was moved to the qāf before it after the qāf was made quiescent, and when two quiescent letters met the yāʾ was dropped; its pattern is فعوا with ḍamma on the ʿayn.
(فعّال) an intensive form of the active participle, and its pattern is its own wording.
(عطاء) , a noun of verbal noun from the quadriliteral verb أعطى, whose regular verbal noun is إعطاء, and the final hamza is changed from the weak letter yāʾ because it came final after an augmentative alif.
(مجذوذ) , a passive participle from the triliteral جذّ on the pattern مفعول with its assimilation undone.
(مرية) , see verse (17) of this surah.
(موفّوهم) , an active participle from the quadriliteral وفّى, its pattern is مفعّوهم with ḍamma on the mīm and the ʿayn.. The word contains a weakening change by omission; its origin is موفّيوهم with ḍamma on the mīm and the yāʾ and kasra on the fāʾ; the ḍamma on the yāʾ was found heavy so it was made quiescent and its vowel moved to the fāʾ, then the yāʾ was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents.
(منقوص) , a passive participle from the triliteral نقص, its pattern is مفعول.

* Rhetoric:
1- Using the passive participle in place of its verb: in the saying of the Exalted «ذلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَجْمُوعٌ لَهُ النَّاسُ وَذلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَشْهُودٌ». The secret in that is what the passive participle carries of indication that the sense of gathering is fixed in the Day, and that it is a Day that must be an appointed time set for gathering the people to it, and that it is described by this as an inseparable attribute; it is also firmer for the attribution of gathering to the people, who never part from it. Its like is the saying of the one issuing a threat: "Your wealth is certainly plundered, O ʿarūb of your people", in which there is a firmness and fixity of the attribute that is not in the verb, and breadth in the adverbial.
2- Metonymy (kināya): in the saying of the Exalted «وَما نُؤَخِّرُهُ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٍ مَعْدُودٍ», i.e. for the end of a short period; counting is a metonymy for fewness, and it may also be made a metonymy for finitude.
3- Combination with separation: the combination is in the saying of the Exalted «لا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ» and the separation in His saying «فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِيٌّ وَسَعِيدٌ».
4- Division (taqsīm): in the saying of the Exalted «فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ شَقُوا» to the end of the verse.
5- Metaphor (istiʿāra): in the saying of the Exalted «لَهُمْ فِيها زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ». The intention is to indicate their distress and grief, likening their state to the state of one whose heart is overcome by heat and whose breath is confined in him, or likening their voices to the voices of donkeys. So in the speech there is either a representational metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya) or an explicit metaphor (istiʿāra muṣarraḥa).

* Benefits:
- The exception occurring in the two verses (107-108): in these two verses the eternity of the people of the Fire in the Fire and the people of Paradise in Paradise is stated, but an exception occurred, namely the saying of the Exalted إِلَّا ما شاءَ رَبُّكَ. We shall now give the opinions of the scholars on this exception. The scholars differed over the two exceptions. Ibn ʿAbbās and al-Ḍaḥḥāk said:
The first exception, mentioned for the people of wretchedness, refers to a group of the believers whom Allah causes to enter the Fire because of sins they committed and then brings them out of it. What proves the soundness of this interpretation is what
was narrated from Jābir, who said: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah the Glorified and Exalted brings a people out of the Fire by intercession and makes them enter Paradise", and in one narration "Allah brings people out of the Fire and makes them enter Paradise." Reported by al-Bukhārī and Muslim.
As for the second exception, mentioned for the people of felicity, it refers to the length of these people's stay in the Fire before their entering Paradise. On this view the meaning of the verse is: As for those who were wretched, they are in the Fire, for them in it is sighing and wailing, abiding in it as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord wills, that He bring them out of it and make them enter Paradise. وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ سُعِدُوا فَفِي الْجَنَّةِ خالِدِينَ فِيها ما دامَتِ السَّماواتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا ما شاءَ رَبُّكَ that He make them enter the Fire first and then bring them out of it and make them enter Paradise. The sum of this view is that each of the two exceptions refers to specific people who are in reality the felicitous, who committed sins by which they deserved a light punishment in the Fire, then are brought out of it and enter Paradise, because the consensus of the Community is that whoever enters Paradise never leaves it. It was also said: the two exceptions refer to both groups, the felicitous and the wretched, and it is the period of their lifespan in the world and their confinement in the barzakh, which is what lies between death and the resurrection, and the period of their standing for reckoning. It was said that the meaning of إِلَّا ما شاءَ رَبُّكَ is "besides what your Lord wills", so the meaning is: abiding in it as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord wills of addition to that. This is like your saying "So-and-so owes me a thousand except two thousand", i.e. besides two thousand. It was said: إلا has the meaning of "and", i.e. "and your Lord has willed the eternity of these in the Fire and the eternity of those in Paradise". It was said: had your Lord willed, He would have brought them out of it, but He did not will, for He has decreed eternity in it for them. Al-Farrāʾ said: this is an exception that Allah made but does not carry out. The sound view is the first, from Ibn ʿAbbās, and the saying of the Exalted proves it «إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِما يُرِيدُ», by bringing out of the Fire whomever He wishes and entering them into Paradise.
And Allah knows best.

safi-cedvel:110-110.t:
* I'rab:
(ولقد آتينا موسى) the verse, its i'rab has been given earlier [Note: In verse (96) of this surah.] , (الكتاب) second direct object, accusative (الفاء) a conjunction (اختلف) a passive past verb (في) a preposition and (الهاء) in the position of a genitive, and the preposition with its genitive noun is the deputy agent, in the position of a nominative (الواو) a conjunction (لولا) a non-jussive particle of condition (كلمة) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the khabar is obligatorily omitted (سبقت) a past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine (من ربّك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (سبقت) .. and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (اللام) the connecting particle of the apodosis of لولا (قضي) a passive past verb, and the deputy agent is omitted, understood from the context, implied "the punishment" (بين) an adverb, accusative, attached to (قضي) and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (الواو) a conjunction (إنّهم) a particle resembling the verb, and its noun (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) (في شك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of inna (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to شك (مريب) naʿt of شك, genitive.
Clause: «آتينا موسى ... » has no grammatical position, the answer to an implied oath.. and the oath clause has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «اختلف فيه» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آتينا.
And the clause: «لولا كلمة ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
And the clause: «سبقت ... » is in the position of a nominative, naʿt of كلمة.
And the clause: «قضي بينهم» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «إنّهم لفي شكّ..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.

safi-cedvel:111-111.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb - an abrogator (nāsikh) - (كلّا) the noun of inna, accusative (لمّا) a particle of negation, jussive and reversal, whose jussive verb has been omitted, the implied form being "لمّا يوفوا أعمالهم" [Note: i.e. "up to now they have not been paid in full, and they will be paid in full".. This is the opinion of Ibn Hishām in al-Mughnī..
Ibn al-Ḥājib implied it as: "لمّا يهملوا" or "لمّا يتركوا".. Ibn Hishām rejected this implication, saying: "the negated verb of (لمّا) is expected to come to be, whereas neglect is not expected to come to be".. As for Abū Ḥayyān, he implied the verb with his saying: "and every one of them is certainly not deducted from the recompense of his deed", because the answer to the oath in the saying of the Exalted ليوفّينهم ربّك أعمالهم indicates it. Moreover the omission of the negated verb of (لمّا) occurs in the tongue of the Arabs; they say "I approached the city and not yet", i.e. "and not yet have I entered it". There are many other statements on the interpretation of the doubled (لمّا) , all of them weak.] , (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath (يوفّينّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative, and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis and (هم) a pronoun in the position of an accusative, direct object (ربّك) agent, nominative.. and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi (أعمالهم) second direct object, accusative.. and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi (إنّه) like the first, with its noun (الباء) a preposition (ما) a maṣdar particle (يعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and the wāw is the agent (خبير) khabar of inna, nominative.
And the interpreted maṣdar (ما يعملون) is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (خبير) .
Clause: «إنّ كلّا لمّا..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «لمّا (يوفوا أعمالهم) » is in the position of a nominative, khabar of inna.
And the clause: «يوفّينّهم ربّك ... » has no grammatical position, the answer to the implied oath..
And the implied oath clause has no grammatical position, a clarifying resumption [Note: The implied oath clause together with its answer has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun or an adjective of (ما) ..
according to those who make the word (لمّا) composed of three words: the lām - which is the shifted one - and the preposition من, and ما a relative noun or an indefinite noun that is described.] .
And the clause: «إنّه ... خبير» has no grammatical position, causal.
And the clause: «يعملون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-like relative (ما) [Note: It may be the ṣila of (ما) as a relative noun, with the returning pronoun omitted, i.e. "by what they do".] .

* Benefits:
- The secrets of the Noble Qur'an:
The scholars of grammar and language were perplexed over the i'rab of the saying of the Exalted in this verse, namely وَإِنَّ كُلًّا لَمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ, and did not reach a decisive opinion. If this indicates anything, it indicates the greatness of the speech of Allah the Mighty and Majestic, and that human minds, however far they reach, cannot grasp its secrets and meanings fully. The speech of Allah the Mighty and Majestic is above mankind and above their minds and conceptions; and from another side, the speech of Allah is too great for the rules of language and the minds of the grammarians to contain it. It is a great overflow that cannot be confined to the moulds of the grammarians or conform to the measure of the rules; it is the origin, the spring, the abundance, and whatever is besides it is shallow and deficient, not reaching a drop of its sea nor a flower of its gardens. In short: it is the speech of Allah.

safi-cedvel:112-113.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive (استقم) an imperative verb, and the agent is "you" (الكاف) a preposition [Note: or a noun meaning "like", in the position of an accusative, a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the verbal noun because it is its attribute, i.e. "stand upright with an uprightness like that which you have been commanded".] , (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (أمرت) a passive past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn..
and (التاء) is the deputy agent, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. "you were commanded it" (الواو) a conjunction (من) a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the agent of استقم [Note: It is not reinforced with a detached pronoun because of the presence of a separator.. and the relative may be a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment) after the wāw of accompaniment.] (تاب) a past verb, and the agent is a latent "he", which is the returning pronoun (معك) an adverb, accusative, attached to (تاب) [Note: or to an omitted ḥāl from the agent of تاب.] and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi (الواو) a conjunction (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing (تطغوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the agent (إنّه بما تعملون بصير) like إنّه ... خبير [Note: In the preceding verse (111).] .
Clause: «استقم ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «أمرت» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (ما) .
And the clause: «تاب ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (من) .
And the clause: «لا تطغوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
And the clause: «إنّه ... بصير» has no grammatical position, causal.
And the clause: «تعملون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-like relative (ما) .
(الواو) a conjunction (لا تركنوا) like لا تطغوا (إلى) a preposition (الذين) a relative in the position of a genitive, attached to (تركنوا) , (ظلموا) a past verb and its agent (الفاء) the fāʾ of causation (تمسّ) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ, and (كم) a pronoun, direct object (النار) agent, nominative.
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن تمسّكم..) is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to a maṣdar gleaned from the preceding speech, i.e. "Let there be no inclining on your part to those who have done wrong, so that the touch of the Fire come upon you".
(الواو) the wāw of ḥāl (ما) negative (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to a preposed khabar (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl from أولياء (الله) the divine name, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (من) a redundant preposition (أولياء) genitive in form, nominative in position, a postposed mubtadaʾ (ثمّ) a conjunction (لا) negative (تنصرون) a passive imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the deputy agent.
And the clause: «لا تركنوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تطغوا.
And the clause: «ظلموا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «تمسّكم النار» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle-like (أن) .
And the clause: «ما لكم.. من أولياء» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the pronoun of address in (تمسّكم) [Note: i.e. "the Fire touches you while you have no helper"] .
And the clause: «لا تنصرون» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause ما لكم.. من أولياء.

* Morphology:
(استقم) , contains a weakening change by omission, for the sake of agreement with the indeclinability on the sukūn; its origin is أستقيم with the yāʾ and mīm quiescent, and the yāʾ was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents; its pattern is استفل.
(تطغوا) , contains a weakening change by omission; its origin is تطغاوا, and when two quiescents met the alif was dropped and the letter before it left with fatḥa as an indication of it; its pattern is تفعوا with fatḥa on the ʿayn.. The alif in the verb is changed from yāʾ because its verbal noun is الطغيان.

* Rhetoric:
1- Concision (ījāz): in the saying of the Exalted «فَاسْتَقِمْ». That is because uprightness is continuing in one direction and not swerving right or left. In sum, this command comprises all the excellences of the rulings, fundamental and derivative, and the perfections, theoretical and practical, and discharging its charge is of the utmost difficulty. For this reason the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "Sūrat Hūd has turned my hair white."
2- Harmony of expression with meaning: in the saying of the Exalted «وَلا تَرْكَنُوا إِلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُ».
Since inclining toward those who have done wrong is less than the doing of the wrongdoers, the punishment for it must be less than the punishment of the wrongdoers; and the touch of the Fire is in reality less than burning. And since burning is the punishment of the wrongdoer, justice requires that the touch be the punishment of the one who inclines to the wrongdoer.
He did not say الظالمين but turned from that to His saying «الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا», because the first allows for continual wrongdoing, which does not suit the touch and does not yield the emphasis obtained from the wording of the second, which has wrongdoing occurring rarely, so as to suit the meaning.

safi-cedvel:114-115.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction (أقم) an imperative verb, and the agent is "you" (الصلاة) direct object, accusative (طرفي) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to أقم, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ (الليل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (الواو) a conjunction (زلفا) conjoined to طرفي, accusative (من الليل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of (زلفا) , (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb (الحسنات) the noun of inna, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra (يذهبن) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of a nominative.. and (النون) is a pronoun in the position of a nominative, agent (السيّئات) direct object, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ, and the demonstrative refers to the demand for uprightness.. and (اللام) is for distance, (والكاف) for address (ذكرى) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif (للذاكرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ذكرى [Note: or to an adjective of ذكرى.] , and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
Clause: «أقم الصلاة» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the imperative clause in the preceding verse [Note: or it is resumptive after the wāw of resumption.] .
And the clause: «إنّ الحسنات يذهبن ... » has no grammatical position, causal.
And the clause: «يذهبن ... » is in the position of a nominative, khabar of inna.
And the clause: «ذلك ذكرى ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
(الواو) a conjunction (اصبر) like أقم (الفاء) causal (إنّ الله لا يضيع) like إنّ الحسنات يذهبن and (لا) negative (أجر) direct object, accusative (المحسنين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
And the clause: «اصبر» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أقم.
And the clause: «إنّ الله لا يضيع ... » has no grammatical position, causal.
And the clause: «لا يضيع ... » is in the position of a nominative, khabar of inna.

* Morphology:
(طرفي) , a noun used as an adverbial because it is annexed to an adverbial..
And see verse (127) of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān.
(زلفا) , plural of زلفة, which is a portion of the night; its pattern is فعلة with ḍamma on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn, and the pattern of زلف is فعل with ḍamma then fatḥa. زلفة may also be pluralised as زلفات with two ḍammas.
(الذاكرين) , plural of الذاكر, an active participle from the triliteral ذكر, its pattern is فاعل.

* Benefits:
- Conditions of repentance:
This noble verse indicates repentance, and that the doing of good deeds is a cause for the erasure of sins and evil deeds.
A sound ḥadīth from the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, came with the meaning of this verse, namely: "And follow an evil deed with a good one, it will erase it, and treat people with good character."
But the matter requires sincere repentance, which has conditions:
1- Abandoning the sin completely. 2- Regret over having done it.
3- Firm resolve not to return to it in the future. When these conditions are met, repentance is valid and accepted, if Allah the Exalted wills. The scholars added that the repentant should return rights to their owners and make up what he missed of the rights of Allah, such as prayer and fasting; and if death hastens upon him before he is able to fulfil them wholly or partly, Allah the Mighty and Majestic will forgive him.

safi-cedvel:116-116.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive (لولا) a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) containing the sense of negation (كان) a complete past verb (من القرون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كان) [Note: or to an omitted ḥāl from (أولو بقيّة) .] , (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of القرون [Note: and that is when (ال) is generic and does not make definite what it enters.. If it is of previous reference (ʿahdiyya), then the preposition with its genitive noun is a ḥāl from القرون.] , and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (أو لو) agent of the verb كان, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw, for it is attached to the sound masculine plural (بقية) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (ينهون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the agent (عن الفساد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينهون) , (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to الفساد [Note: or to a ḥāl from it.] , (إلّا) a particle of exception (قليلا) excepted, accusative, and the exception is connected or disconnected [Note: If the urging keeps its meaning, the exception is disconnected and (إلّا) means "but".] (من) a preposition (من) a relative noun in the position of a genitive, attached to an adjective of (قليلا) , (أنجينا) a past verb and its agent (من) like the first and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to a ḥāl from the omitted object, i.e. "we saved him from among them" (الواو) a conjunction (اتّبع) a past verb (الذين) a relative noun in the position of a nominative, agent (ظلموا) a past verb and its agent (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of an accusative, direct object (أترفوا) a passive past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the deputy agent (فيه) like منهم, attached to (أترفوا) , (الواو) a conjunction (كانوا) a defective past verb - an abrogator - and the wāw is the noun of kāna (مجرمين) khabar of kāna, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
Clause: «لولا كان من القرون ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «ينهون ... » is in the position of a nominative, naʿt of (أولو) [Note: or in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from (أولو) because it was specified by annexation.] .
And the clause: «أنجينا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (من) .
And the clause: «اتّبع الذين ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. "so they did not forbid corruption, and those who did wrong followed ..."
And the clause: «ظلموا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «أترفوا فيه» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (ما) .
And the clause: «كانوا مجرمين» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause اتّبع الذين [Note: It may be a parenthetical clause of appendage (iʿtirāḍ tadhyīlī).] .

* Morphology:
(بقيّة) , has two possibilities: an adjective on the pattern فعيلة for intensiveness with the sense of فاعلة, hence the tāʾ entered it, and what is meant by it is the best and choicest of a thing.. or a verbal noun with the sense of البقوى like التقيّة with the sense of التقوى, i.e. "possessors of remaining". And see verse (86) of this surah.

safi-cedvel:117-117.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (ما) negative (كان) a defective past verb (ربّك) the noun of kāna, nominative.. and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi (اللام) the lām of denial or disavowal (lām al-juḥūd) (يهلك) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, and the agent is "he" (القرى) direct object, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif (بظلم) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl from the agent of يهلك. (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl (أهلها) mubtadaʾ, nominative.. and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (مصلحون) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن يهلك) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted khabar of كان.
Clause: «ما كان ربّك ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «يهلك ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle-like (أن) .
And the clause: «أهلها مصلحون» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from القرى [Note: but not in the sense that the verb is restricted by what occurs as a ḥāl from its agent; rather it is unrestricted by that.] .

safi-cedvel:118-120.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (لو) a non-jussive particle of condition (شاء) a past verb (ربّك) agent, nominative.. and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi (اللام) the connecting particle of the apodosis of لو (جعل) like شاء, and the agent is "he" (الناس) direct object, accusative (أمّة) second direct object, accusative (واحدة) naʿt of أمة, accusative (الواو) a conjunction (لا يزالون) a defective imperfect verb - an abrogator - nominative.. and the wāw is the noun of لا يزال (مختلفين) khabar of لا يزالون, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
Clause: «شاء ربّك ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «جعل الناس ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «لا يزالون ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e. "but He did not will, so the people differed and they continue to differ".
(إلّا) a particle of exception (من) a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of an accusative as the excepted (رحم ربّك) like شاء ربّك (الواو) resumptive (اللام) a preposition [Note: Abū Ḥayyān said: "This lām, in truth, is the lām of consequence (lām al-ṣayrūra).. i.e. He created them so that their affair would end in disagreement; this does not conflict with His saying: وما خلقت الجنّ والإنس إلّا ليعبدون, since the meaning of that is the command to worship."] , (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable in the position of a genitive, attached to (خلقهم) [Note: The commentators differed greatly about what it points to; the more apparent is that it returns to the disagreement and to the mercy.] ..
and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address (خلق) a past verb and (هم) a pronoun, direct object, and the agent is "he" (الواو) a conjunction (تمّت) a past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine (كلمة) agent, nominative (ربّك) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.. and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath (أملأن) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative..
and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and the agent is "I" (جهنّم) direct object, accusative (من الجنّة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أملأن) , (الناس) conjoined to الجنّة with the wāw, genitive like it (أجمعين) tawkīd maʿnawī (semantic emphasis) of الناس, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
And the clause: «رحم ربّك ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (من) .
And the clause: «خلقهم» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «تمّت كلمة ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خلقهم.
And the clause: «أملأن ... » has no grammatical position, the answer to an implied oath.. and the implied oath clause with its answer has no grammatical position, explicative.
(الواو) a conjunction (كلّا) a preposed direct object, its operator being نقصّ [Note: or it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the verbal noun, i.e. "every story we relate", and the object of نقصّ is His saying: ما نثبّت..] , (نقص) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "we", expressing majesty (على) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (نقصّ) , (من أنباء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of (كلّا) [Note: or attached to (نقصّ) .] , (الرسل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of an accusative, badal (substitute) of (كلّا) [Note: or an indefinite noun that is described, or a maṣdar particle.
