Or a khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, implied "it is".] , (نثبّت) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "we", expressing majesty (فؤادك) direct object, accusative.. and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl (جاءك) a past verb.. and (الكاف) is the direct object (في) a preposition (ها) a particle of alerting (ذه) a demonstrative, indeclinable in the position of a genitive, attached to a ḥāl from (الحقّ) [Note: or attached to (جاء) .] which is the agent of جاء, nominative (الواو) a conjunction in both places (موعظة، ذكرى) two nouns conjoined to الحقّ, nominative, the sign of the nominative in ذكرى being the ḍamma implied on the alif (للمؤمنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ذكرى, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
And the clause: «نقصّ ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خلقهم.
And the clause: «نثبّت ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (ما) [Note: or in the position of an accusative, naʿt of the indefinite noun that is described, (ما) .. or it is the ṣila of the particle-like (ما) , and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of an accusative.] .
And the clause: «جاءك.. الحقّ» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from الأنباء, with an implied قد.

* Morphology:
(مختلفين) , plural of مختلف, an active participle from the quinqueliteral اختلف, its pattern is مفتعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:121-122.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (قل) an imperative verb, and the agent is "you" (اللام) a preposition (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of a genitive, attached to (قل) , (لا) negative (يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the agent (اعملوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable by the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the agent (على مكانتكم إنّا عاملون) the i'rab of its like has been given earlier [Note: In verse (93) of this surah.] , and the sign of the nominative of the khabar is the wāw.
Clause: «قل ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «لا يؤمنون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «اعملوا ... » is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
And the clause: «إنّا عاملون» has no grammatical position, a clarifying resumption.. or causal.
(الواو) a conjunction (انتظروا إنّا منتظرون) like اعملوا.. إنّا عاملون.
And the clause: «انتظروا ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause اعملوا.
And the clause: «إنّا منتظرون» has no grammatical position, a clarifying resumption.. or causal.

safi-cedvel:123-123.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, a preposed khabar (غيب) a postposed mubtadaʾ, nominative (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (الأرض) conjoined to السموات with the wāw, genitive (الواو) a conjunction (إلى) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the verb (يرجع) which is a passive imperfect, nominative (الأمر) the deputy agent, nominative (كلّه) tawkīd maʿnawī (semantic emphasis) of الأمر, nominative like it.. and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (الفاء) the connecting particle of an implied conditional apodosis (اعبد) an imperative verb, and the agent is "you" and (الهاء) a pronoun, direct object (الواو) a conjunction (توكّل) like اعبد (عليه) like إليه, attached to (توكّل) , (الواو) a conjunction (ما) negative, operating like ليس (ربّك) the noun of ما, nominative and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi (الباء) a redundant preposition (غافل) genitive in form, accusative in position, khabar of ما (عن) a preposition (ما) a maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun, or an indefinite noun that is described, with the returning pronoun omitted in both cases, i.e. "you do it".] (تعملون) like يؤمنون [Note: In verse (121) of this surah.] .
And the interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون) is in the position of a genitive by the preposition, attached to غافل.
Clause: «لله غيب السموات ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «يرجع الأمر ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
And the clause: «اعبده..» is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if the whole matter belongs to Allah, then worship Him".
And the clause: «توكّل ... » is conjoined to the clause اعبده.
And the clause: «ما ربّك بغافل ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لله غيب ...
And the clause: «تعملون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-like relative (ما) .
